text: Haaland yana son barin Dortmund a bazarar nan kuma ya matsu ya tafi Real Madrid . ( ABC - in Spanish ) Manchester United na sha'awar daukar dan wasann Barcelona dan asalin kasar Guniea da ke buga gasar ' yan kasa da shekara 17 a Sifaniya Ilaix Moriba , mai shekara 18 . ( Mundo Deportivo - in Spanish ) Paris St-Germain ta shirya sabunta kwangilar dan wasan Faransar Kylian Mbappe , mai shekara 22 , inda za ta ba shi euro 30m ( £25 . 8m ) domin hana Real Madrid da Liverpool daukarsa . ( L'Equipe via Mirror ) Barcelona na son daukar dan wasan Manchester City da Argentina Sergio Aguero , mai shekara 32 , da kuma dan kwallon Liverpool dan kasar Netherlands Georginio Wijnaldum , mai shekara 30 , a lokacin musayar ' yan kwallo na bazara . ( AS via Sport Witness ) Juventus na ci gaba da sanya ido kan halin da dan wasan Manchester United Paul Pogba yake ciki , a yayin da kwangilar dan wasan na Faransa mai shekara 28 za ta kare a watan Yunin 2022 . ( Calciomercato - in Italian ) Tottenham za ta yi asarar £25m idan ta sallami kocinta Jose Mourinho daga aiki . ( Mirror ) Barcelona za ta bai wa dan wasan Argentina Lionel Messi , mai shekara 33 , kwangila ta tsawon rayuwarsa a bazarar nan a yunkurin da take yi na hana shi barin kungiyar amma za ta nemi ya amince a rage albashinsa . ( Mundo Deportivo - in Spanish ) Har yanzu West Ham ba ta tattauna game da sayen dan wasan Manchester United da Ingila Jesse Lingard , baki daya ba . Dan wasan mai 28 yana zaman aro a kungiyar . ( Football London ) Napoli na sha'awar dan wasan Liverpool dan kasar Girka Kostas Tsimikas , mai shekara 24 , wanda sau shida kawai ya murza leda tun da ya je kungiyar a bazarar da ta wuce . ( Corriere dello Sport via Sport Witness ) Liverpool da Tottenham sun bayyana sha'awarsu ta daukar dan wasan Amurka Matthew Hoppe , mai shekara 20 , daga Schalke . ( Transfermarkt - in German ) Ana duba yiwuwar nada tsohon kocin Juventus Massimiliano Allegri a matsayin kocin Napoli domin ya maye gurbin Gennaro Gattuso . ( Calciomercato - in Italian )

Real Madrid da Barcelona sun shirya gogayya da Manchester City , Manchester United da kuma Chelsea a yunkurin daukar dan wasan Borussia Dortmund da Norway Erling Braut Haaland , mai shekara 20 . ( AS - in Spanish )

language: Oromo (orm)
text: Hidhattoonni kunneen ALI Ebla 11 , 2013 Wiixata darbe irraa kaasanii Aanaa Seedaal guutummaatti to'achuu odeeffannoo argadheera jedhe komishiniin kun ibsa baase keessatti . Godinni Kamaashii gara Kibba Beenishaangul Gumuzitti kan argamtu yoo taatu , aanaan hidhattoota harka galteetti jedhamte Seedaal jiraattota 25 , 00 caalan of keessaa qabdi jedha Komishiniin Mirgoota Namoomaa Itoophiyaa . Haleellaa hidhattoonni kunneen aanaa kana irratti raawwatan hordofee bulchaa aanaa fi poolisoota dabalatee jiraattonni aanichaa hedduun baqatanii ba'aniiru , akka ibsa komishinii kanaatti . Dhimma kanarratti mootummaan naannichaas tahe , kan Federaalaa ammatti wanti jedhan hinjiru . Komishiniin Mirgoota Namoomaa Itoophiyaa dhaabbata mootummaa Itoophiyaan hundaa'e yoo tahu , aangoo sarbama mirgoota namoomaa qorachuufi biroon itti kennameera . Komishinichi dhiibbaa mootummaarraa bilisa akka tahes hima . Komishinichi ibsa guyyaa Kamisaa baaseen , hidhattoonni haleellaa raawwataniin jiraattota aanaa Seedaal , hooggantoota aanaa fi godinaa akkasumas hojjettoota mootummaa ajjeesuu fi qabeenya mootummaa fi dhuunfaa barbadeessan jedha . Komishinichi jiraattota aanaa Seedaal irraa yaada argadheera jechuun akka ibsetti , hidhattoonni kunneen humna mootummaa naannoo jiruun ol ta'uu fi humni nageenyaa dabalataa garas ergameera jedhames bakka kana hin geenyee jedheera . Komishiniin mirga namoomaa kun waa'ee eenyummaa hidhattoota aanaa Seedaal to'achuun haleellaa qaqqabsiisaniiru jedhee homaayyuu hin ibsine . Mootummaan dhimma kanaaf xiyyeeffannaa kennuun , humnoota nageenya lammiilee eegsisan garasitti dabalataan ramadee lubbuu lammiilee gaaga'amaa hamaa fi dhiittaa mirga namoomaa daran hammaachuu hedu irraa tiksuu qaba jechuun dhaameera komishiniin kun . Taateen kun rakkoo nageenyaa naannocha keessa bubbule irraa kan dhufeedha kan jedhe ibsi komishinichaa , taateen akkanaa baay'ee kan isa yaaddessu ta'uu eere . Rakkoo mudate kana ilaalchisuun mootummaa naannoo Beenishaangul Gumuz fi mootummaa federaalaa waliin dubbachaa akka jirus ibseera . Kallattii lixa Itoophiyaatiin Sudaan waliin wal-daangeessee kan argamu naannoon Beenishaangul Gumuz , godinaalee sadi jechuunis Matakkal , Kamaashii fi Asoosaa of keessaa qaba .

language: Oromo (orm)
text: Hidhattoonni kunneen ALI Ebla 11 , 2013 Wiixata darbe irraa kaasanii Aanaa Seedaal guutummaatti to'achuu odeeffannoo argadheera jedhe komishiniin kun ibsa baase keessatti . Godinni Kamaashii gara Kibba Beenishaangul Gumuzitti kan argamtu yoo taatu , aanaan hidhattoota harka galteetti jedhamte Seedaal jiraattota 25 , 00 caalan of keessaa qabdi jedha Komishiniin Mirgoota Namoomaa Itoophiyaa . Haleellaa hidhattoonni kunneen aanaa kana irratti raawwatan hordofee bulchaa aanaa fi poolisoota dabalatee jiraattonni aanichaa hedduun baqatanii ba'aniiru , akka ibsa komishinii kanaatti . Dhimma kanarratti mootummaan naannichaas tahe , kan Federaalaa ammatti wanti jedhan hinjiru . Komishiniin Mirgoota Namoomaa Itoophiyaa dhaabbata mootummaa Itoophiyaan hundaa'e yoo tahu , aangoo sarbama mirgoota namoomaa qorachuufi biroon itti kennameera . Komishinichi dhiibbaa mootummaarraa bilisa akka tahes hima . Komishinichi ibsa guyyaa Kamisaa baaseen , hidhattoonni haleellaa raawwataniin jiraattota aanaa Seedaal , hooggantoota aanaa fi godinaa akkasumas hojjettoota mootummaa ajjeesuu fi qabeenya mootummaa fi dhuunfaa barbadeessan jedha . Komishinichi jiraattota aanaa Seedaal irraa yaada argadheera jechuun akka ibsetti , hidhattoonni kunneen humna mootummaa naannoo jiruun ol ta'uu fi humni nageenyaa dabalataa garas ergameera jedhames bakka kana hin geenyee jedheera . Komishiniin mirga namoomaa kun waa'ee eenyummaa hidhattoota aanaa Seedaal to'achuun haleellaa qaqqabsiisaniiru jedhee homaayyuu hin ibsine . Mootummaan dhimma kanaaf xiyyeeffannaa kennuun , humnoota nageenya lammiilee eegsisan garasitti dabalataan ramadee lubbuu lammiilee gaaga'amaa hamaa fi dhiittaa mirga namoomaa daran hammaachuu hedu irraa tiksuu qaba jechuun dhaameera komishiniin kun . Taateen kun rakkoo nageenyaa naannocha keessa bubbule irraa kan dhufeedha kan jedhe ibsi komishinichaa , taateen akkanaa baay'ee kan isa yaaddessu ta'uu eere . Rakkoo mudate kana ilaalchisuun mootummaa naannoo Beenishaangul Gumuz fi mootummaa federaalaa waliin dubbachaa akka jirus ibseera . Kallattii lixa Itoophiyaatiin Sudaan waliin wal-daangeessee kan argamu naannoon Beenishaangul Gumuz , godinaalee sadi jechuunis Matakkal , Kamaashii fi Asoosaa of keessaa qaba .<|im_end|>

Kaleessa galagala konkolaataa Bishooftuudhaa gara Adaamaa imalaa turte garagaluun namni tokko du'uun namoota 14 irra miidhaan qaamaa cimaan dhaqabuu himaniiru Saajin Yebaalewarqi . Dabalataan kaleessa Godina Arsii aanaa Adaabbaa ganda awwashootti konkolaataan minibaasii namoota fe'ee saffisa guddaan deemaa ture garagaluun namootni torba yoo du'an , namoota shan irra miidhaa cimaa , sadii irra immoo miidhaa salphaan dhaqqabuu himaniiru . Godina Wallaggaa Bahaa aanaa Leeqaa Dullachaatti konkolaataan ' Odaa Baas ' Magaalaa Mattuu irraa gara Finfinnee osoo deemaa jiruu sababa saffisa guddaan imalaa tureef garagaluun lubbuun namoota lamaa darbuun namoota 10 irra miidhaa qaamaa cimaa , 21 irra immoo miidhaa salphaan dhaqqabuu Saajin Yebaalewarqi himaniiru . Balaa konkolaataa magaalaa Hoolataatti kaleessa dhaqqabee lubbuu namoota 18 galaafate . Akkasumas Godina Shawaa Bahaa aanaa Dugdaatti ammoo konkolaataan fe'umsaa Isuzu baajaajii waliin walitti bu'uun namootni afur yoo du'an , namoota sadii irra miidhaan qaamaa dhaqqabeera . Godina Arsii aanaa Diigaluu fi Xiijootti konkolaataan dedebisa uummataa nama farda yaabbatee deemutti bu'uun lubbuun namichaas kan fardaas darbuu Saajin Yebaleewarqi Dejenee BBCtti himaniiru . Bara 2011 keessa balaan tiraafikaa Oromiyaa keessaa hir'achuu kan himan Saajin Yebaalewarqi , bara kana ammoo sababa roobaan wal qabatee balaan dhaqqabu dabalaa jira jedhan .

language: Hausa (hau)
text: Haaland yana son barin Dortmund a bazarar nan kuma ya matsu ya tafi Real Madrid . ( ABC - in Spanish ) Manchester United na sha'awar daukar dan wasann Barcelona dan asalin kasar Guniea da ke buga gasar ' yan kasa da shekara 17 a Sifaniya Ilaix Moriba , mai shekara 18 . ( Mundo Deportivo - in Spanish ) Paris St-Germain ta shirya sabunta kwangilar dan wasan Faransar Kylian Mbappe , mai shekara 22 , inda za ta ba shi euro 30m ( £25 . 8m ) domin hana Real Madrid da Liverpool daukarsa . ( L'Equipe via Mirror ) Barcelona na son daukar dan wasan Manchester City da Argentina Sergio Aguero , mai shekara 32 , da kuma dan kwallon Liverpool dan kasar Netherlands Georginio Wijnaldum , mai shekara 30 , a lokacin musayar ' yan kwallo na bazara . ( AS via Sport Witness ) Juventus na ci gaba da sanya ido kan halin da dan wasan Manchester United Paul Pogba yake ciki , a yayin da kwangilar dan wasan na Faransa mai shekara 28 za ta kare a watan Yunin 2022 . ( Calciomercato - in Italian ) Tottenham za ta yi asarar £25m idan ta sallami kocinta Jose Mourinho daga aiki . ( Mirror ) Barcelona za ta bai wa dan wasan Argentina Lionel Messi , mai shekara 33 , kwangila ta tsawon rayuwarsa a bazarar nan a yunkurin da take yi na hana shi barin kungiyar amma za ta nemi ya amince a rage albashinsa . ( Mundo Deportivo - in Spanish ) Har yanzu West Ham ba ta tattauna game da sayen dan wasan Manchester United da Ingila Jesse Lingard , baki daya ba . Dan wasan mai 28 yana zaman aro a kungiyar . ( Football London ) Napoli na sha'awar dan wasan Liverpool dan kasar Girka Kostas Tsimikas , mai shekara 24 , wanda sau shida kawai ya murza leda tun da ya je kungiyar a bazarar da ta wuce . ( Corriere dello Sport via Sport Witness ) Liverpool da Tottenham sun bayyana sha'awarsu ta daukar dan wasan Amurka Matthew Hoppe , mai shekara 20 , daga Schalke . ( Transfermarkt - in German ) Ana duba yiwuwar nada tsohon kocin Juventus Massimiliano Allegri a matsayin kocin Napoli domin ya maye gurbin Gennaro Gattuso . ( Calciomercato - in Italian )

Real Madrid da Barcelona sun shirya gogayya da Manchester City , Manchester United da kuma Chelsea a yunkurin daukar dan wasan Borussia Dortmund da Norway Erling Braut Haaland , mai shekara 20 . ( AS - in Spanish )

language: Oromo (orm)
text: Innis biyyasaa Iskootilaand osoo hin taane Veetinamaitti ture kan yaala argataa ture . ' Dhiigni kiyya ititee ture , kaleen kiyyas hojii dhaabdee turte , kutaan qaamaa kiyya biroos hojii dhaabanii turan , sombi kiyya % 10 qofaan tajaajila kennaa ture , ' jedha Isteefan Kaameroon . Dhukkubni Covid - 19 itti hammaatee doktoraan , qondaltoota fi miidiyaalee Veetinamiin hordofamaa ture . ' Yeroo sanitti Eezihiyaa keessatti namni akka kee dhukkubsate hin jiru naan jedhanii turan . ' Bayyanachuuf ' yeroo dheeraa ' itti fudhata jedhu doktoroonni isaa . ' Miidhaa koronaavaayirasiin geessisu beekuuf ani fakkeenyadha , vaayirasichis dhugaadha , ' jechuun siree hospitalaa Iskootilaanditti argamurraa BBC'tti himeera . Hamaan ni dhufa jedhanii eeguu ' Yeroo ta'e hiriyyaan kiyya Kiraag carraan lubbuun hafuu kiyya % 10 akka ta'e itti himamee ture , kanaaf wanti hamaa dhufuu danda'a jedhee eegaa ture . ' ' Saanduqa keessa kaa'amee dhufa jedhee waan namni tokko godhuu qabu hojjataa ture , ' jechuun hospitaalaa magaalaa Hoo Chii Miinh irraa BBC'tti himeera . Isteefan dhukkubbii keessa jiraatus Veetinamitti dhukkusachuusaatiif carra qabeessadha ofiin jedha . Veetinam biyya ummata miiliyoona 95 qabduu fi namoota Covid - 19 qabaman 420 qofa qabdudha . Biyyattiinis dhukkubsattoota Covid - 19 kutaa yaala addaa ICU keessatti argaman muraasaa kan qabdu yoo taatu namni sababa Covid - 19 du'e tokkollee hin jiru . ' Osoo bakka biraa ta'ee nan du'a ture , ' jedhe ji'a Waxabajjii keessa . ' Kunuunsa ummanni Veetinam naa godheen baay'ee gammadeera . Doktoroota harka isaanitti akka hin duuneef hojjataa turaniif kabaja guddaa qaba . ' ' Akka nama maaratoonii fiiguuti ' Dr Maanish Paatel gorsaa sirna hargansuu fi doktora eega Isteefan Kameeroon Iskootilaanditti deebi'e booda hordoffii taasisaaniifi jiraniidha . Isaanis yeroo dheeraa eega koomaa keessa ture booda lubbuun hafuusaa ' waan addaati ' jedhu . ' Namoonni dhukkubsataan yeroo kutaa ICU galan akka nama maaratoonii fiiguuti jedhu . Taateen Isteefan mudate immoo maaratoonii maaratoonii caaludha , ' jechuun Dr Maanish BBC'tti himaniiru . Isteefan yeroo koomaa keessa ture sanitti kg30 hir'iseera . Ammas ta'u dhaabbatee deemuuf rakkachaa jira . ' Yeroo jalqaba koomaa keessaa bahu , irra deebi'ee deemuu danda'aa laata ? jedhee yaada ture . Sababa miilli kiyya akka jiru hin beekneef Kana booda miilli kiyya waan deemuu natti hin fakkaanne ture , ' jedha . Kaayyoon Isteefan ' jalqaba waggaa itti aanutti ' irra deebi'ee xiyyaara balaliisuudha . Sababa weerara koronaavaayiras hojiin isaas rakkoo keessa galeera . Dhukkubbii Covid - 19 haaraa Veetinam biyyoota koronaavayiras ittisuuf tarkaanfii gaarii fudhatan keessaa ishee tokkodha . Ta'us garuu eega magaalaa Daa Naang kan daawwattootaan beekamtutti namoonni haaraa afur Covid - 19 qabaman booda mootummaa deeggarsa taasisaa jira . Namoonni haaraa qabaman kunneen isaa biyyoota biroorraa dhufan osoo hin taane isaanuma biyya keessa jiraniidha . Guyyaa Wiixataa MM Nguyen Xuan Phuc jiraattoonni Daa Naang irra deebiidhaan fageenyasaanii akka eegan himaniiru . Dabaltaanis warroonni tajaajila murteessoo hin kennine akka cufaman ajajaniiru . Daawwattoonnis guyyoota 14 ' f gara biyyattii hin seenan , isaan 80 , 00 ta'n immoo gara biyyaatti akka deebi'an ni taasifamu . MM Phuc magaalattiin guutumatti uggurri akka hin labsamne ibsaniiru .

text: Innis biyyasaa Iskootilaand osoo hin taane Veetinamaitti ture kan yaala argataa ture . ' Dhiigni kiyya ititee ture , kaleen kiyyas hojii dhaabdee turte , kutaan qaamaa kiyya biroos hojii dhaabanii turan , sombi kiyya % 10 qofaan tajaajila kennaa ture , ' jedha Isteefan Kaameroon . Dhukkubni Covid - 19 itti hammaatee doktoraan , qondaltoota fi miidiyaalee Veetinamiin hordofamaa ture . ' Yeroo sanitti Eezihiyaa keessatti namni akka kee dhukkubsate hin jiru naan jedhanii turan . ' Bayyanachuuf ' yeroo dheeraa ' itti fudhata jedhu doktoroonni isaa . ' Miidhaa koronaavaayirasiin geessisu beekuuf ani fakkeenyadha , vaayirasichis dhugaadha , ' jechuun siree hospitalaa Iskootilaanditti argamurraa BBC'tti himeera . Hamaan ni dhufa jedhanii eeguu ' Yeroo ta'e hiriyyaan kiyya Kiraag carraan lubbuun hafuu kiyya % 10 akka ta'e itti himamee ture , kanaaf wanti hamaa dhufuu danda'a jedhee eegaa ture . ' ' Saanduqa keessa kaa'amee dhufa jedhee waan namni tokko godhuu qabu hojjataa ture , ' jechuun hospitaalaa magaalaa Hoo Chii Miinh irraa BBC'tti himeera . Isteefan dhukkubbii keessa jiraatus Veetinamitti dhukkusachuusaatiif carra qabeessadha ofiin jedha . Veetinam biyya ummata miiliyoona 95 qabduu fi namoota Covid - 19 qabaman 420 qofa qabdudha . Biyyattiinis dhukkubsattoota Covid - 19 kutaa yaala addaa ICU keessatti argaman muraasaa kan qabdu yoo taatu namni sababa Covid - 19 du'e tokkollee hin jiru . ' Osoo bakka biraa ta'ee nan du'a ture , ' jedhe ji'a Waxabajjii keessa . ' Kunuunsa ummanni Veetinam naa godheen baay'ee gammadeera . Doktoroota harka isaanitti akka hin duuneef hojjataa turaniif kabaja guddaa qaba . ' ' Akka nama maaratoonii fiiguuti ' Dr Maanish Paatel gorsaa sirna hargansuu fi doktora eega Isteefan Kameeroon Iskootilaanditti deebi'e booda hordoffii taasisaaniifi jiraniidha . Isaanis yeroo dheeraa eega koomaa keessa ture booda lubbuun hafuusaa ' waan addaati ' jedhu . ' Namoonni dhukkubsataan yeroo kutaa ICU galan akka nama maaratoonii fiiguuti jedhu . Taateen Isteefan mudate immoo maaratoonii maaratoonii caaludha , ' jechuun Dr Maanish BBC'tti himaniiru . Isteefan yeroo koomaa keessa ture sanitti kg30 hir'iseera . Ammas ta'u dhaabbatee deemuuf rakkachaa jira . ' Yeroo jalqaba koomaa keessaa bahu , irra deebi'ee deemuu danda'aa laata ? jedhee yaada ture . Sababa miilli kiyya akka jiru hin beekneef Kana booda miilli kiyya waan deemuu natti hin fakkaanne ture , ' jedha . Kaayyoon Isteefan ' jalqaba waggaa itti aanutti ' irra deebi'ee xiyyaara balaliisuudha . Sababa weerara koronaavaayiras hojiin isaas rakkoo keessa galeera . Dhukkubbii Covid - 19 haaraa Veetinam biyyoota koronaavayiras ittisuuf tarkaanfii gaarii fudhatan keessaa ishee tokkodha . Ta'us garuu eega magaalaa Daa Naang kan daawwattootaan beekamtutti namoonni haaraa afur Covid - 19 qabaman booda mootummaa deeggarsa taasisaa jira . Namoonni haaraa qabaman kunneen isaa biyyoota biroorraa dhufan osoo hin taane isaanuma biyya keessa jiraniidha . Guyyaa Wiixataa MM Nguyen Xuan Phuc jiraattoonni Daa Naang irra deebiidhaan fageenyasaanii akka eegan himaniiru . Dabaltaanis warroonni tajaajila murteessoo hin kennine akka cufaman ajajaniiru . Daawwattoonnis guyyoota 14 ' f gara biyyattii hin seenan , isaan 80 , 00 ta'n immoo gara biyyaatti akka deebi'an ni taasifamu . MM Phuc magaalattiin guutumatti uggurri akka hin labsamne ibsaniiru .<|im_end|>

text: ባለሥልጣኑ ይህን ድርጊት አልፈፀምኩም በማለት የእምነት ክህደት ቃላቸውን ሰጥተዋል ። የሻሮን ኦቲየኖ ሬሳ ጫካ ውስጥ ከተገኘ በኋላ ነው ሁኔታው ወደ ፍርድ ቤት እንዲቀርብ ከበርካቶች ጫና መበርታት የጀመረው ። • ቻይናዊው በዘረኛ ንግግሩ ምክንያት ከሃገር ሊባረር ነው የአስከሬን ምርመራው እንዳረጋገጠው የ26 ዓመቷ ሻሮን ተደፍራ እና በስለት 8 ቦታ ተወግታ ነው የተገኘችው ፤ ሽሉም በጥቃቱ ጊዜ ሕይወቱ እንዳለፈ ተረጋግጧል ። ሚጎሪ የተሰኘው የኬንያ ግዛት አስተዳዳተሪ የሆኑት እኚህ ግለሰብ በፖሊስ ቁጥጥር ሥር የሚገኙ ሲሆን ክሱ ወደ ፍርድ ቤት ተልኳል ። የፍርድ ቤቱ ዳኛ ባልሥልጣኑ ብቻ ሳይሆኑ ሁለት አጋሮቻቸው በቁጥጥር ሥር እንዲውሉ አዘዋል ፤ አንዱ በግድያ ሌላኛው ደግሞ በማስተባበር ወንጀል ተጠርጥረው ። አቃቤ ሕግ ሻሮን እና ሃገረ ገዢ ኦባዶ የፍቅር ግንኙነት እንደነበራቸው አረጋግጫለሁ ብሎ እርግዝናው ግን ያልተፈለገ ነው ፤ በተለይ ደግሞ በተጠርጣሪ በኩል ሲል አክሏል ። • ጉግል ኢንተርኔትን በላስቲክ ከረጢት ይዞ ኬንያ ገብቷል የሟች እና የተጠርጣሪው ኦባዶ ግንኙነት ሃገር ያወቀው ፤ ፀሐይ የሞቀው ነው በተለይ ደግሞ ባለሥልጣኑ በሚያስተዳድሩት አካባቢ ሲል አቃቤ ሕግ ጉዳዩን አብራርቷል ። የሃገር ገዢው ኦባዶ ባለቤት የባላቸውን ከትዳር ውጭ የተመሠረት ግንኙት እያወቁት ባለሥልጣኑ ይህን ድርጊት መፈፀማቸው ደግሞ ክሱን ያከብደዋል ይላል አቃቤ ሕግ ። በርካታ ኬንያዊያንን ያስቆጣው ይህ ድርጊት በቅርብ ቀን ፍርድ ያገኛል ተብሎ ይጠበቃል ። • ኬንያ ሺሻን አገደች
ኦኮት ኦባዶ የተባሉት ኬንያዊ ከፍተኛ ባለሥልጣን ከትዳራቸው ውጪ ግንኙነት የነበራቸውን ነብሰጡር ጓደኛቸውን በጭካኔ እንድትገደል አዘዋል እንዲሁም አስተባብረዋል በሚል ክስ ቀርቦባቸዋል ።

text: Haaland yana son barin Dortmund a bazarar nan kuma ya matsu ya tafi Real Madrid . ( ABC - in Spanish ) Manchester United na sha'awar daukar dan wasann Barcelona dan asalin kasar Guniea da ke buga gasar ' yan kasa da shekara 17 a Sifaniya Ilaix Moriba , mai shekara 18 . ( Mundo Deportivo - in Spanish ) Paris St-Germain ta shirya sabunta kwangilar dan wasan Faransar Kylian Mbappe , mai shekara 22 , inda za ta ba shi euro 30m ( £25 . 8m ) domin hana Real Madrid da Liverpool daukarsa . ( L'Equipe via Mirror ) Barcelona na son daukar dan wasan Manchester City da Argentina Sergio Aguero , mai shekara 32 , da kuma dan kwallon Liverpool dan kasar Netherlands Georginio Wijnaldum , mai shekara 30 , a lokacin musayar ' yan kwallo na bazara . ( AS via Sport Witness ) Juventus na ci gaba da sanya ido kan halin da dan wasan Manchester United Paul Pogba yake ciki , a yayin da kwangilar dan wasan na Faransa mai shekara 28 za ta kare a watan Yunin 2022 . ( Calciomercato - in Italian ) Tottenham za ta yi asarar £25m idan ta sallami kocinta Jose Mourinho daga aiki . ( Mirror ) Barcelona za ta bai wa dan wasan Argentina Lionel Messi , mai shekara 33 , kwangila ta tsawon rayuwarsa a bazarar nan a yunkurin da take yi na hana shi barin kungiyar amma za ta nemi ya amince a rage albashinsa . ( Mundo Deportivo - in Spanish ) Har yanzu West Ham ba ta tattauna game da sayen dan wasan Manchester United da Ingila Jesse Lingard , baki daya ba . Dan wasan mai 28 yana zaman aro a kungiyar . ( Football London ) Napoli na sha'awar dan wasan Liverpool dan kasar Girka Kostas Tsimikas , mai shekara 24 , wanda sau shida kawai ya murza leda tun da ya je kungiyar a bazarar da ta wuce . ( Corriere dello Sport via Sport Witness ) Liverpool da Tottenham sun bayyana sha'awarsu ta daukar dan wasan Amurka Matthew Hoppe , mai shekara 20 , daga Schalke . ( Transfermarkt - in German ) Ana duba yiwuwar nada tsohon kocin Juventus Massimiliano Allegri a matsayin kocin Napoli domin ya maye gurbin Gennaro Gattuso . ( Calciomercato - in Italian )

Real Madrid da Barcelona sun shirya gogayya da Manchester City , Manchester United da kuma Chelsea a yunkurin daukar dan wasan Borussia Dortmund da Norway Erling Braut Haaland , mai shekara 20 . ( AS - in Spanish )

language: Nigerian Pidgin (pcm)
text: Chelsea get intentions to leave di European Super League as fans protest their involvement outside Stamford Bridge Efforts to leave come just two days after both of dem announce as two of six English clubs wey sign up to di controversial new competition . Di ESL don come under serious criticism since dem announce am on Sunday . Around 1 , 00 fans gather outside Chelsea Stamford Bridge home ground before their game against Brighton on Tuesday to protest their involvement . Chelsea and City bin dey part of English football ' big six ' clubs - alongside Arsenal , Liverpool , Manchester United and Tottenham - wey agree to join di new league . In total , 12 European clubs announce their intentions to form di breakaway league , which dem hope to establish as new midweek competition . Football authorities and government ministers for UK and across Europe togeda wit Uefa and leagues associations condemn dia decision . Chelsea na di first club to indicate say dem no go press ahead as dem prepare documentation to withdraw . City come later withdraw soon after . Chelsea and City bin no be di drivers of di plan , dem bin be di last to sign and fear bin dey say dem go leave dem behind . E no dey clear how easy e be or how binding di contracts be . Na Chelsea owner Roman Abramovich and di club board make di decision to try and make Chelsea leave after dem witness negative global reaction to di Super League . Fear bin dey say e fit cause damage to di club reputation and e go undermine some of e campaign and community work . Questions wey dem raise internally as to whether fans go respond to di club if dem continue with di proposal wey don go down badly . Dem make di decision earlier on Tuesday before protests bin start outside Stamford Bridge . Earlier in di day , UK Prime Minister Boris Johnson meet wit di Football Association , Premier League officials and fans ' representatives , after which di government tok say dem go will take ' whatever action wey dey necessary ' , including legislative options , to ensure dem stop di proposals . Johnson stance dey supported by Labour and di Liberal Democrats . For statement wey dem release after meeting between di Premier League and di 14 clubs wey no involve , dem say dem ' unanimously and vigorously ' reject plans for di competition . Dem add say dem dey consider ' all actions available ' to stop di competition and ask di six teams to end their involvement immediately . While English involvement don quickly dey reconsidered , no indication don dey from di other six clubs from Spain and Italy - wey include Real Madrid , Barcelona , Atletico Madrid , Inter Milan , Juventus and AC Milan - weda dem dey consider to do di same . Real president Florentino Perez , wey dem name as di ESL chairman , say di competition bin dey set up ' to save football ' because young pipo ' no longer dey interested ' for di game because of ' a lot of poor quality games ' . AC Milan chief executive Ivan Gazidis say di ESL go be ' new , exciting chapter for di game ' and say dem go ' provide value and support ' across European football . Meanwhile , Juventus manager Andrea Pirlo come out to support di ESL and di club owner Andrea Agnelli , wey quit as European Club Association ( ECA ) chairman after im sign up di Turin club up to di new competition . ' Im explain say dis project to us , e give us great confidence , but di most important tin im tell us na say we gats to continue with our work , ' Pirlo tok .

In total , 12 European clubs announce their intentions to form di breakaway league , which dem hope to establish as new midweek competition . Football authorities and government ministers for UK and across Europe togeda wit Uefa and leagues associations condemn dia decision . Chelsea na di first club to indicate say dem no go press ahead as dem prepare documentation to withdraw . City come later withdraw soon after . ' ' Deeggartoota aartii hedduu argachuun ulfaataa waan ta'eef , baasiidhuma kootiin wanta narraa eegamu hojjedhen agarsiisa jedheen itti seenes , ' jetti Bashaatuun . Hojiilee aartii bara 2009 keessa hojjetamanii fi biyya keessatti hojjetaman adda baasuun , abbootiin seeraa ogummaa aartii garagaraa keessa jiran qabxilee filatamaniin calalliin raawwatuus himteetti . Callallii boodas namoota marsaa dhumaaf darban uumanni karaa ergaa gabaabaa akka filatan taasifamuu dubbatti Bashaatuun . Sagaleen uummataa harka 40 yoo qabaatu harki 60 ammoo maddaallii saayinsaawaa ogeeyyiiti jetti . ' Badhaasni kun bara baraan kan kennamuu waan ta'eef kan barana hojiilee bara 2009 keessatti hojetaman qofa waldorgomsisne , ' jetti . ' ' Biyyoota alaatti , Awuroopaa fi Ameerikaattis fiilmiinii fi muuziqaan ni hojjetama garuu isaan carraalee hedduu waan qabaniif warra biyya keessaa waliin dorgomsiisuun ni ulfata , ' ' jechuun sababa hojiilee biyya keessaa qofa waldorgomisiisan ibsiti . text: Haaland yana son barin Dortmund a bazarar nan kuma ya matsu ya tafi Real Madrid . ( L'Equipe via Mirror ) Barcelona na son daukar dan wasan Manchester City da Argentina Sergio Aguero , mai shekara 32 , da kuma dan kwallon Liverpool dan kasar Netherlands Georginio Wijnaldum , mai shekara 30 , a lokacin musayar ' yan kwallo na bazara . ( Football London ) Napoli na sha'awar dan wasan Liverpool dan kasar Girka Kostas Tsimikas , mai shekara 24 , wanda sau shida kawai ya murza leda tun da ya je kungiyar a bazarar da ta wuce . ( Corriere dello Sport via Sport Witness ) Liverpool da Tottenham sun bayyana sha'awarsu ta daukar dan wasan Amurka Matthew Hoppe , mai shekara 20 , daga Schalke . ( Transfermarkt - in German ) Ana duba yiwuwar nada tsohon kocin Juventus Massimiliano Allegri a matsayin kocin Napoli domin ya maye gurbin Gennaro Gattuso . ( Calciomercato - in Italian )

Real Madrid da Barcelona sun shirya gogayya da Manchester City , Manchester United da kuma Chelsea a yunkurin daukar dan wasan Borussia Dortmund da Norway Erling Braut Haaland , mai shekara 20 . ( AS - in Spanish )

text: እተን ደቂ ኣንስትዮ ሰንበት ንጉሆ ናብ ዝሰርሓሉ ቦታ ብመኪና ኣብ ዝጓዓዛሉ ብዕጡቓት ከምዝቐተላ ወሃቢ ቃል ሓደ ቤት ፍርዲ ንኤኤፍፒ ተዛሪቡ ፡ ፡ እቲ ካብ ቀረባ እዋናት ናብዚ ጋዜጠኛታት ፣ ጎስጎስትን ፖለቲከኛታትን ዒላማ ገይሩ ዝፍጸም ዘሎ ቅትለት ፡ ፕረዚደንት ኣመሪካ ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ወታሃደራቱ ካብ ኣፍጋኒስታን ብቐጻሊ ምስሓብ ምስጀመረ እዩ ተጓሃሂሩ ዘሎ ፡ ፡ ቁጽሪ ኣብታ ሃገር ዝተረፉ ወታሃደራት ኣመሪካ 2500 ጥራሕ እንትኾን ፡ እቲ ስጉምቲ ኣብታ ህድኣት ዘይብላ ኣፍጋኒስታን ተወሳኺ ዘይምርግጋእ ዝፈጥር ከምዝኾነ ምክትል ፕረዚደንት ኣፍጋኒስታን ኣብዚ ሰሙን ንቢቢሲ ተዛሪቡ እዩ ፡ ፡ እተን ዳያኑ ብመን ተቐቲለን ? እተን ደቂ ኣንስትዮ ሰንበት ንጉሆ ብዝተፈጸመን ሃንደበታዊ መጥቃዕቲ ዝተቐተላ ኮይነን ፡ እቲ መራሒ መኪና እውን ቆሲሉ እዩ ፡ ፡ ነቲ ቓሊ ፋቱላህ ኣብ ዝተባህለ ከባቢ ካቡል ዝተፈጸመ መጥቃዕቲ ዛጊድ ሓላፍነት ዝወሰደ ኣካል የለን ፡ ፡ እቲ ንመብዛሕተኦም ኣብ ቀረባ እዋን ዝተፈጸሙ ቅትለታት ፈጺሙ ክኾን ከምዝኽእል ዝጥርጠር ጣሊባን እውን ፡ ዝሃቦ መግለጺ የለን ፡ ፡ እቲ ናይ ሰንበት ንጉሆ ቅትለት ተወከልቲ መንግስቲ ኣፍጋኒስታንን ዕጡቓት ጣሊባንን ኣብ ዶሃ ዘተ ሰላም የካይዱ ኣብዘለዉሉ እዋን እዩ ተፈጺሙ ዘሎ ፡ ፡

text: ባለሥልጣኑ ይህን ድርጊት አልፈፀምኩም በማለት የእምነት ክህደት ቃላቸውን ሰጥተዋል ። የሻሮን ኦቲየኖ ሬሳ ጫካ ውስጥ ከተገኘ በኋላ ነው ሁኔታው ወደ ፍርድ ቤት እንዲቀርብ ከበርካቶች ጫና መበርታት የጀመረው ። • ቻይናዊው በዘረኛ ንግግሩ ምክንያት ከሃገር ሊባረር ነው የአስከሬን ምርመራው እንዳረጋገጠው የ26 ዓመቷ ሻሮን ተደፍራ እና በስለት 8 ቦታ ተወግታ ነው የተገኘችው ፤ ሽሉም በጥቃቱ ጊዜ ሕይወቱ እንዳለፈ ተረጋግጧል ። ሚጎሪ የተሰኘው የኬንያ ግዛት አስተዳዳተሪ የሆኑት እኚህ ግለሰብ በፖሊስ ቁጥጥር ሥር የሚገኙ ሲሆን ክሱ ወደ ፍርድ ቤት ተልኳል ። የፍርድ ቤቱ ዳኛ ባልሥልጣኑ ብቻ ሳይሆኑ ሁለት አጋሮቻቸው በቁጥጥር ሥር እንዲውሉ አዘዋል ፤ አንዱ በግድያ ሌላኛው ደግሞ በማስተባበር ወንጀል ተጠርጥረው ። አቃቤ ሕግ ሻሮን እና ሃገረ ገዢ ኦባዶ የፍቅር ግንኙነት እንደነበራቸው አረጋግጫለሁ ብሎ እርግዝናው ግን ያልተፈለገ ነው ፤ በተለይ ደግሞ በተጠርጣሪ በኩል ሲል አክሏል ። • ጉግል ኢንተርኔትን በላስቲክ ከረጢት ይዞ ኬንያ ገብቷል የሟች እና የተጠርጣሪው ኦባዶ ግንኙነት ሃገር ያወቀው ፤ ፀሐይ የሞቀው ነው በተለይ ደግሞ ባለሥልጣኑ በሚያስተዳድሩት አካባቢ ሲል አቃቤ ሕግ ጉዳዩን አብራርቷል ። የሃገር ገዢው ኦባዶ ባለቤት የባላቸውን ከትዳር ውጭ የተመሠረት ግንኙት እያወቁት ባለሥልጣኑ ይህን ድርጊት መፈፀማቸው ደግሞ ክሱን ያከብደዋል ይላል አቃቤ ሕግ ። በርካታ ኬንያዊያንን ያስቆጣው ይህ ድርጊት በቅርብ ቀን ፍርድ ያገኛል ተብሎ ይጠበቃል ። • ኬንያ ሺሻን አገደች
ኦኮት ኦባዶ የተባሉት ኬንያዊ ከፍተኛ ባለሥልጣን ከትዳራቸው ውጪ ግንኙነት የነበራቸውን ነብሰጡር ጓደኛቸውን በጭካኔ እንድትገደል አዘዋል እንዲሁም አስተባብረዋል በሚል ክስ ቀርቦባቸዋል ።

language: Hausa (hau)
text: Haaland yana son barin Dortmund a bazarar nan kuma ya matsu ya tafi Real Madrid . ( ABC - in Spanish ) Manchester United na sha'awar daukar dan wasann Barcelona dan asalin kasar Guniea da ke buga gasar ' yan kasa da shekara 17 a Sifaniya Ilaix Moriba , mai shekara 18 . ( Mundo Deportivo - in Spanish ) Paris St-Germain ta shirya sabunta kwangilar dan wasan Faransar Kylian Mbappe , mai shekara 22 , inda za ta ba shi euro 30m ( £25 . 8m ) domin hana Real Madrid da Liverpool daukarsa . ( L'Equipe via Mirror ) Barcelona na son daukar dan wasan Manchester City da Argentina Sergio Aguero , mai shekara 32 , da kuma dan kwallon Liverpool dan kasar Netherlands Georginio Wijnaldum , mai shekara 30 , a lokacin musayar ' yan kwallo na bazara . ( AS via Sport Witness ) Juventus na ci gaba da sanya ido kan halin da dan wasan Manchester United Paul Pogba yake ciki , a yayin da kwangilar dan wasan na Faransa mai shekara 28 za ta kare a watan Yunin 2022 . ( Calciomercato - in Italian ) Tottenham za ta yi asarar £25m idan ta sallami kocinta Jose Mourinho daga aiki . ( Mirror ) Barcelona za ta bai wa dan wasan Argentina Lionel Messi , mai shekara 33 , kwangila ta tsawon rayuwarsa a bazarar nan a yunkurin da take yi na hana shi barin kungiyar amma za ta nemi ya amince a rage albashinsa . ( Mundo Deportivo - in Spanish ) Har yanzu West Ham ba ta tattauna game da sayen dan wasan Manchester United da Ingila Jesse Lingard , baki daya ba . Dan wasan mai 28 yana zaman aro a kungiyar . ( Football London ) Napoli na sha'awar dan wasan Liverpool dan kasar Girka Kostas Tsimikas , mai shekara 24 , wanda sau shida kawai ya murza leda tun da ya je kungiyar a bazarar da ta wuce . ( Corriere dello Sport via Sport Witness ) Liverpool da Tottenham sun bayyana sha'awarsu ta daukar dan wasan Amurka Matthew Hoppe , mai shekara 20 , daga Schalke . ( Transfermarkt - in German ) Ana duba yiwuwar nada tsohon kocin Juventus Massimiliano Allegri a matsayin kocin Napoli domin ya maye gurbin Gennaro Gattuso . ( Calciomercato - in Italian )

Real Madrid da Barcelona sun shirya gogayya da Manchester City , Manchester United da kuma Chelsea a yunkurin daukar dan wasan Borussia Dortmund da Norway Erling Braut Haaland , mai shekara 20 . ( AS - in Spanish )

language: Rundi (run)
text: Impirimbanyi zari hanze y'icyumba cy'urukiko rw'ikirenga zasabwe n'ibyishimo Uyu mwanzuro w'urukiko uburijemo uwo mu mwaka wa 2013 washimangiraga itegeko rimaze imyaka 157 ryo mu bihe by'ubukoloni - rizwi nk'icyiciro cya 377 - ryavugaga ko imibonano mpuzabitsina y'ab ' igitsina kimwe ifatwa nk ' ' icyaha kinyuranya n'imiterere kamere . ' Ni rimwe mu mategeko ashaje cyane ku isi yahanaga abakora imibonano mpuzabitsina b'igitsina kimwe , Ubuhinde bukaba bwari bumaze igihe bwigononwa kuriburizamo . Impirimbanyi zari hanze y'icyumba cy'urukiko rw'ikirenga zasabwe n'ibyishimo ndetse bamwe muri bo basuka amarira y'ibyishimo ubwo urukiko rwatangazaga uwo mwanzuro . Ubwo yasomaga uwo mwanzuro , Dipak Misra , umukuru w'urukiko rw'ikirenga rw'Ubuhinde , yagize ati : ' Kugira imibonano mpuzabitsina icyaha gihanwa n'amategeko ntibishyize mu gaciro , bihutiyeho kandi bigaragara ko binyuranyije n'itegeko - nshinga . ' Indu Malhotra , undi mucamanza wo mu rukiko rw'ikirenga rw'Ubuhinde , yavuze ko yemeza ko ' amateka akwiye gusaba imbabazi ' ababana b'igitsina kimwe kubera kubashyira mu kato .

language: Hausa (hau)
text: Haaland yana son barin Dortmund a bazarar nan kuma ya matsu ya tafi Real Madrid . ( ABC - in Spanish ) Manchester United na sha'awar daukar dan wasann Barcelona dan asalin kasar Guniea da ke buga gasar ' yan kasa da shekara 17 a Sifaniya Ilaix Moriba , mai shekara 18 . ( Mundo Deportivo - in Spanish ) Paris St-Germain ta shirya sabunta kwangilar dan wasan Faransar Kylian Mbappe , mai shekara 22 , inda za ta ba shi euro 30m ( £25 . 8m ) domin hana Real Madrid da Liverpool daukarsa . ( L'Equipe via Mirror ) Barcelona na son daukar dan wasan Manchester City da Argentina Sergio Aguero , mai shekara 32 , da kuma dan kwallon Liverpool dan kasar Netherlands Georginio Wijnaldum , mai shekara 30 , a lokacin musayar ' yan kwallo na bazara . ( AS via Sport Witness ) Juventus na ci gaba da sanya ido kan halin da dan wasan Manchester United Paul Pogba yake ciki , a yayin da kwangilar dan wasan na Faransa mai shekara 28 za ta kare a watan Yunin 2022 . ( Calciomercato - in Italian ) Tottenham za ta yi asarar £25m idan ta sallami kocinta Jose Mourinho daga aiki . ( Mirror ) Barcelona za ta bai wa dan wasan Argentina Lionel Messi , mai shekara 33 , kwangila ta tsawon rayuwarsa a bazarar nan a yunkurin da take yi na hana shi barin kungiyar amma za ta nemi ya amince a rage albashinsa . ( Mundo Deportivo - in Spanish ) Har yanzu West Ham ba ta tattauna game da sayen dan wasan Manchester United da Ingila Jesse Lingard , baki daya ba . Dan wasan mai 28 yana zaman aro a kungiyar . ( Football London ) Napoli na sha'awar dan wasan Liverpool dan kasar Girka Kostas Tsimikas , mai shekara 24 , wanda sau shida kawai ya murza leda tun da ya je kungiyar a bazarar da ta wuce . ( Corriere dello Sport via Sport Witness ) Liverpool da Tottenham sun bayyana sha'awarsu ta daukar dan wasan Amurka Matthew Hoppe , mai shekara 20 , daga Schalke . ( Transfermarkt - in German ) Ana duba yiwuwar nada tsohon kocin Juventus Massimiliano Allegri a matsayin kocin Napoli domin ya maye gurbin Gennaro Gattuso . ( Calciomercato - in Italian )

Real Madrid da Barcelona sun shirya gogayya da Manchester City , Manchester United da kuma Chelsea a yunkurin daukar dan wasan Borussia Dortmund da Norway Erling Braut Haaland , mai shekara 20 . ( AS - in Spanish )

language: Rundi (run)
text: Ingabo za Ethiopia zatanguye ibitero muri Tigray itariki 4 ukwezi kwa 11 Iryo shirahamwe rifise icicaro muri Reta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika rivuga ko ibitero vyarenze ku ' mategeko y'intambara ' rigasaba reta gukora amatohoza . Reta ntiyashotse igira ico ishikiriza ku bivugwa na Human Rights ariko yari isanzwe imaze kuvuga ko ingabo zayo zitwaye neza . Imihana , amashure , ibitaro n'amasoko navyo nyene vyaratewe igihe ibisasu bikomakomeye vyariko biraterwa ata gutoranya ku bisagara vya Tigray , nk'uko biri muri ico cegeranyo . Abanyagihugu basanzwe 83 ( civil ) , barimwo abana , barishwe , abarenga 300 nabo barakomereka , ku bwa Human Rights Watch . Ibi bivuguruza umushikiranganji wa mbere Abiy Ahmed imbere yaho yemeje ko ata munyagihugu asanzwe yishwe n'ingabo za reta mpuzantara muri iyo ntambara . Mu gihe reta iriko irugurura bukebuke amayira yo kwinjiza imfashanyo muri iyo ntara , iracanana kurekurira abarorerezi mpuzamakungu gushika yo . Iyo ntambara yatanguye inyuma yaho ikambi ya gisirikare iterewe n'abagwanyi b'umugambwe watwara iyo ntara , Tigray People's Liberation Front ( TPLF ) . Benshi mu ndongozi za TPLF barishwe canke barafatwa , ariko umukuru w'uwo mugambwe n'ubu aracinyegeje .

Iyo ntambara yatanguye inyuma yaho ikambi ya gisirikare iterewe n'abagwanyi b'umugambwe watwara iyo ntara , Tigray People's Liberation Front ( TPLF ) . text: Haaland yana son barin Dortmund a bazarar nan kuma ya matsu ya tafi Real Madrid . ( ABC - in Spanish ) Manchester United na sha'awar daukar dan wasann Barcelona dan asalin kasar Guniea da ke buga gasar ' yan kasa da shekara 17 a Sifaniya Ilaix Moriba , mai shekara 18 . ( Mundo Deportivo - in Spanish ) Paris St-Germain ta shirya sabunta kwangilar dan wasan Faransar Kylian Mbappe , mai shekara 22 , inda za ta ba shi euro 30m ( £25 . 8m ) domin hana Real Madrid da Liverpool daukarsa . ( L'Equipe via Mirror ) Barcelona na son daukar dan wasan Manchester City da Argentina Sergio Aguero , mai shekara 32 , da kuma dan kwallon Liverpool dan kasar Netherlands Georginio Wijnaldum , mai shekara 30 , a lokacin musayar ' yan kwallo na bazara . ( AS via Sport Witness ) Juventus na ci gaba da sanya ido kan halin da dan wasan Manchester United Paul Pogba yake ciki , a yayin da kwangilar dan wasan na Faransa mai shekara 28 za ta kare a watan Yunin 2022 . ( Calciomercato - in Italian ) Tottenham za ta yi asarar £25m idan ta sallami kocinta Jose Mourinho daga aiki . ( Mirror ) Barcelona za ta bai wa dan wasan Argentina Lionel Messi , mai shekara 33 , kwangila ta tsawon rayuwarsa a bazarar nan a yunkurin da take yi na hana shi barin kungiyar amma za ta nemi ya amince a rage albashinsa . ( Mundo Deportivo - in Spanish ) Har yanzu West Ham ba ta tattauna game da sayen dan wasan Manchester United da Ingila Jesse Lingard , baki daya ba . Dan wasan mai 28 yana zaman aro a kungiyar . ( Football London ) Napoli na sha'awar dan wasan Liverpool dan kasar Girka Kostas Tsimikas , mai shekara 24 , wanda sau shida kawai ya murza leda tun da ya je kungiyar a bazarar da ta wuce . ( Corriere dello Sport via Sport Witness ) Liverpool da Tottenham sun bayyana sha'awarsu ta daukar dan wasan Amurka Matthew Hoppe , mai shekara 20 , daga Schalke . ( Transfermarkt - in German ) Ana duba yiwuwar nada tsohon kocin Juventus Massimiliano Allegri a matsayin kocin Napoli domin ya maye gurbin Gennaro Gattuso . ( Calciomercato - in Italian )

Real Madrid da Barcelona sun shirya gogayya da Manchester City , Manchester United da kuma Chelsea a yunkurin daukar dan wasan Borussia Dortmund da Norway Erling Braut Haaland , mai shekara 20 . ( AS - in Spanish )

language: Oromo (orm)
text: Filannoo Pireezidantummaa Ameerikaa Sadaasa darbe gaggeeffameen Doonaald Tiraampiin injifachuun kan filataman Joo Baayidan guyyaa Roobii waadaa galuu isaaniin dura torbanootni turan muraasni ce'eumsa aangoo kanatti qormaata jabaa ta'anii ture . Doonaald Tiraamp bu'aan filannoo waan waliin dhahameef hin fudhadhu jechuun hanga yeroo dhiyootti aangoo dabarsuuf rincica agariisaa turan . Amajjii 6 darbe ammoo guyyaa koongireesiin injifannoo Baayidan mirkaneessu haleellaa deeggartootni Tiraamp raawwatan haala nageenyaa ce'uumsa aangoo ittii yaaddessaa godheera . Baayidaniin kan filataman Kaamalaa Hariis seenaa US keessatti Pireezidantii itti aantuu dubartii kan jalqabaa ta'uun waadaa galaniiru . Doonaald Tiraamp ganama har'aa sirna waadaa galuu Baayidan irratti osoo hin argamiin , ganamaan gara qe'ee isaanii Filooridaatti godaananiiru . Kana gochuu isaaniinis seenaa waggoota 150 biyyattii keessatti pireezidantii jalqabaa ta'aniiru . Pireezidantii itti aanaan Tiraamp , Maayik Peens garuu sirna kanarratti argamaniiru . Sirna waadaa galuu akka durii namni kumoota hedduun lakkaa'amu irratti hin argamne kana irratti , Tiraampiin alatti Pireezidantootni duranii sadii argamaniiru . Kamaalaa Hariis kan Pireezidantii itti aantuu ta'uun waadaa galaniis seenaa US keessatti dubartii aangoo kana qabatan isaan duraa ta'aniiru . kanatti dabalataan harmeen isaanii dhalattuu Hindii ta'uun abbaan isaanii ammoo nama gurraacha ta'uunis seenaa biraadha . Kamaalaa Hariis sadarkaa kanarra gahuu isaaniif dubartoota isaan dura qabsaa'aa turaniif galata galchaniiru . ' Demokraasiin injifate ! ' - Haasaa isaanii jalqabaan maal jedhan ? Baayidan ' ' Guyyaan kun guyyaa Ameerikaanootaa , guyyaa Dimookrasiiti ' ' jechuun erga waadaa galanii haasaa isaanii jalqabaniiru . Dimookraasiin injifateeras jechuun dubbatan . Wanti ijaaramu , wanti suphamu hedduun jira jechuunis himan . Baayidan haasaa isaanii keessatti pireezidantoota duraanii biyyattii paartii lamaanuurraa sagantaa har'aarratti argaman galateeffatan . Sirna kanarratti Pireezidantootni duraanii akka Kiliintan , Buush fi Obaamaan argamaniiru . Warra isaan mormaniifis wal qixa tajaajiluuf waadaa kan galan Baayidan , ' ' hunda keessaniifin Pireezidantii ta'a ' ' jedhan . Tokkumaan akka cimuufis dhaaman . ' ' Tokkummaan daandii fuula duraati ' ' wal dhagahaa waliif kabaja kennuun akka jiraatus gaafatan . Barri aangoo isaanii qormaata hedduu fuula duraa qabaachuu himanii , danqaawwan jiran hundumaa akka irra aanaan dubbatan . Heera biyyattii akka tiksan , Ameerikaa akka tiksan waadaa galaniiru dubbii isaanii keessatti .

Doonaald Tiraamp bu'aan filannoo waan waliin dhahameef hin fudhadhu jechuun hanga yeroo dhiyootti aangoo dabarsuuf rincica agariisaa turan . Amajjii 6 darbe ammoo guyyaa koongireesiin injifannoo Baayidan mirkaneessu haleellaa deeggartootni Tiraamp raawwatan haala nageenyaa ce'uumsa aangoo ittii yaaddessaa godheera . Baayidaniin kan filataman Kaamalaa Hariis seenaa US keessatti Pireezidantii itti aantuu dubartii kan jalqabaa ta'uun waadaa galaniiru . Doonaald Tiraamp ganama har'aa sirna waadaa galuu Baayidan irratti osoo hin argamiin , ganamaan gara qe'ee isaanii Filooridaatti godaananiiru . Kana gochuu isaaniinis seenaa waggoota 150 biyyattii keessatti pireezidantii jalqabaa ta'aniiru . Pireezidantii itti aanaan Tiraamp , Maayik Peens garuu sirna kanarratti argamaniiru . Sirna waadaa galuu akka durii namni kumoota hedduun lakkaa'amu irratti hin argamne kana irratti , Tiraampiin alatti Pireezidantootni duranii sadii argamaniiru . Sirna kanarratti Pireezidantootni duraanii akka Kiliintan , Buush fi Obaamaan argamaniiru . language: Somali (som)
text: . Qalalaasahaasi wuxu dhacay ka dib markii laba askari oo booliska Israa'iil ah ay toogteen dabley Carabta dhalashada Israa'iil haysata ah oo markii dambena booliska oo eryanayaa ku dileen Xaram Al-Shariif dhexdiisa . Rabshadda ayaa ahayd tii ugu darnayd ee sanadihii dambe ka dhacda magaalada Qudus , waxaana ay sare u qaadday xiisadda u dhexeysa Israa'iil iyo Falastiiniyiinta . Israa'iil ayaa gaadhtay go'aan aan laga filayn , markii ay Muslimiinta Qudus u diiday in salaadii Jimcaha ay ku tukadaan Masjidul Aqsa , tallaabadaas oo ka cadhaysiisay Muslimiinta iyo dalka Urdun oo ah khaadimka masaajidkaa barakaysan . Al-Aqsa ayaa xidhnaa Sabtidii oo dhan , waxaana sidoo kale ay Israa'iil bandoo gelisay qeybta qadiimiga ah ee magaalada Qudus . Dawladda Israa'iil ayaa sheegtay in xidhitaanku muhiim u ahaa hawlgalka ammaan ee ay ciidamadeedu ka wadeen deegaankaas . Haweeney u hadashay booliska Israa'iil oo lagu magacaabo Luba Samri , ayaa sheegtay in albaabka masjidka hadda lagu xiray qalabka dadka lagu baadho iyo kamarado . Ra'iisul wasaaraha Israa'iil , Benjamin Netanyahu , ayaa khadka telefoonka kula hadlay boqor Cabdallaha Urdun , waxaanu boqorku cambaareeyay weerarka lala beegsaday booliska Israa'iil , isagoo dhanka kale ugu baaqay Netanyahu inuu xannibaada ka qaado masaajidka , xiisaddana dejiyo . Waxay u badan tahay in xiisad dheeraad ah ay ka dhalato qalabka baadhitaanka loo adeegsanayo ee ay Israa'iil ku rakibtay albaabada masjidka . language: Rundi (run)
text: Imyiyerekano yadutse mu duce twinshi two muri Tunisia harimwo n'umugwa mukuru Tunis Iyo myiyerekano yatanguye himirije isabukuru y'indwi y'ikugwa rya Prezida Zine al-Abidine Ben Ali ku munsi wa Mungu . Ubutegetsi bwaragize amanama kubera iyo myiyerekano , abantu barenga 800 bakaba barafashwe . Mu rugendo Prezida Beji Caid Essebsi yagize mw'ikomine ya Tunis ku munsi wa Mungu , yavuze ko ategera akababaro k'abanyagihugu . Prezida akikujwe n'abanyepolitike hamwe n'abakoresha Imigambwe itavuga rumwe n'ubutegetsi yahamagariye abanyagihugu mu myiyerekano ku munsi wa Mungu , ivuga ko ata kintu kirahinduka kuva aho Ben Ali akuriwe ku butegetsi igihe hatanguye imigumuko yo gusaba amahinduka . Iyo myiyerekano yatanguye ryari , itegwa n'iki ? Iyo myiyerekano yatanguye itariki 7 z'ukwezi kwa mbere igihe ubutegetsi budugirije amakori , bukaduza n'ibiciro vy'ibidandazwa , igihe bushikiriza urutonde rw'amahera azokoreshwa mu 2018 . Iyo myiyerekano yabereye mu duce 10 dutandukanye turimwo umugwa mukuru Tunis , abayirimwo basaba ko urwo rutonde rw'amahera rwohebwa . Yatanguye mu mahoro munyuma hadukamwo amakimbirane hagati y'igipolisi n'abihaye amabarabara .

ኦኮት ኦባዶ የተባሉት ኬንያዊ ከፍተኛ ባለሥልጣን ከትዳራቸው ውጪ ግንኙነት የነበራቸውን ነብሰጡር ጓደኛቸውን በጭካኔ እንድትገደል አዘዋል እንዲሁም አስተባብረዋል በሚል ክስ ቀርቦባቸዋል ።

language: Hausa (hau)
text: Haaland yana son barin Dortmund a bazarar nan kuma ya matsu ya tafi Real Madrid . ( ABC - in Spanish ) Manchester United na sha'awar daukar dan wasann Barcelona dan asalin kasar Guniea da ke buga gasar ' yan kasa da shekara 17 a Sifaniya Ilaix Moriba , mai shekara 18 . ( Mundo Deportivo - in Spanish ) Paris St-Germain ta shirya sabunta kwangilar dan wasan Faransar Kylian Mbappe , mai shekara 22 , inda za ta ba shi euro 30m ( £25 . 8m ) domin hana Real Madrid da Liverpool daukarsa . ( L'Equipe via Mirror ) Barcelona na son daukar dan wasan Manchester City da Argentina Sergio Aguero , mai shekara 32 , da kuma dan kwallon Liverpool dan kasar Netherlands Georginio Wijnaldum , mai shekara 30 , a lokacin musayar ' yan kwallo na bazara . ( AS via Sport Witness ) Juventus na ci gaba da sanya ido kan halin da dan wasan Manchester United Paul Pogba yake ciki , a yayin da kwangilar dan wasan na Faransa mai shekara 28 za ta kare a watan Yunin 2022 . ( Calciomercato - in Italian ) Tottenham za ta yi asarar £25m idan ta sallami kocinta Jose Mourinho daga aiki . ( Mirror ) Barcelona za ta bai wa dan wasan Argentina Lionel Messi , mai shekara 33 , kwangila ta tsawon rayuwarsa a bazarar nan a yunkurin da take yi na hana shi barin kungiyar amma za ta nemi ya amince a rage albashinsa . ( Mundo Deportivo - in Spanish ) Har yanzu West Ham ba ta tattauna game da sayen dan wasan Manchester United da Ingila Jesse Lingard , baki daya ba . Dan wasan mai 28 yana zaman aro a kungiyar . ( Football London ) Napoli na sha'awar dan wasan Liverpool dan kasar Girka Kostas Tsimikas , mai shekara 24 , wanda sau shida kawai ya murza leda tun da ya je kungiyar a bazarar da ta wuce . ( Corriere dello Sport via Sport Witness ) Liverpool da Tottenham sun bayyana sha'awarsu ta daukar dan wasan Amurka Matthew Hoppe , mai shekara 20 , daga Schalke . ( Transfermarkt - in German ) Ana duba yiwuwar nada tsohon kocin Juventus Massimiliano Allegri a matsayin kocin Napoli domin ya maye gurbin Gennaro Gattuso . ( Calciomercato - in Italian )

Real Madrid da Barcelona sun shirya gogayya da Manchester City , Manchester United da kuma Chelsea a yunkurin daukar dan wasan Borussia Dortmund da Norway Erling Braut Haaland , mai shekara 20 . ( AS - in Spanish )

language: Amharic (amh)
text: የሜደስን ሳንስ ፍሮንቲርስ ሪፖርት እንደሚለው ፤ ነሐሴ 26 / 2010 ዓ.ም ላይ ሁለት አንስተኛ ጀልባዎች ጉዟቸውን ጀመሩ ። ይሁን እንጂ ከፕላስቲክ የተሰራችው አንደኛዋ ጀልባ ከግዑዝ ነገር ጋር ተጋጭታ አየር ጎድሏት ሰጥማለች ። ከአደጋው የተረፉ 276 የሚሆኑ ስደተኖች የሊቢያ የወደብ ከተማ ወደ ሆነችው ካሆምስ ተወስደዋል ። ተጎጂዎቹ ከመዲናዋ በደቡብ ምስራቅ በምትገኝው ካሆምስ ሆስፒታል ውስጥ የህክምና ዕርዳታ እየተደረገላቸው ነው ። • ካለሁበት 1 ፡ ' ' በሜዲትራንያን ባህር ከመስመጥ መትረፌ ሁሌም ይደንቀኛል ' የሜደስን ሳንስ ፍሮንቲርስ ሪፖርት እንደሚለው ከሆነ ስደተኞቹን ፖሊስ በዓይነ ቁራኛ እየተከታተላቸው ነው ። ከተጎጂዎቹ መካከል ነብሰ-ጡር እናቶች ፣ ጨቅላዎች እና ህጻናት ይገኙበታል ። ሜደስን ሳንስ ፍሮንቲርስ የሳምባምች ታማሚዎችን እና በነዳጅ ፍሳሽ ምክንያት ቆዳቸው የተቃጠሉ ሰዎችን አክሚያለው ብሏል ። ባለፉት 9 ወራት ብቻ ከ1500 ስደተኞች በላይ ሜዲትራኒያን ባህርን ለማቋረጥ ጥረት ሲያደርጉ ህይወታቸው ማለፉን ዓለም አቀፉ የስደተኞች ተቋም ገልጿል ።

text: የሜደስን ሳንስ ፍሮንቲርስ ሪፖርት እንደሚለው ፤ ነሐሴ 26 / 2010 ዓ.ም ላይ ሁለት አንስተኛ ጀልባዎች ጉዟቸውን ጀመሩ ። ይሁን እንጂ ከፕላስቲክ የተሰራችው አንደኛዋ ጀልባ ከግዑዝ ነገር ጋር ተጋጭታ አየር ጎድሏት ሰጥማለች ። ከአደጋው የተረፉ 276 የሚሆኑ ስደተኖች የሊቢያ የወደብ ከተማ ወደ ሆነችው ካሆምስ ተወስደዋል ። ተጎጂዎቹ ከመዲናዋ በደቡብ ምስራቅ በምትገኝው ካሆምስ ሆስፒታል ውስጥ የህክምና ዕርዳታ እየተደረገላቸው ነው ። • ካለሁበት 1 ፡ ' ' በሜዲትራንያን ባህር ከመስመጥ መትረፌ ሁሌም ይደንቀኛል ' የሜደስን ሳንስ ፍሮንቲርስ ሪፖርት እንደሚለው ከሆነ ስደተኞቹን ፖሊስ በዓይነ ቁራኛ እየተከታተላቸው ነው ። ከተጎጂዎቹ መካከል ነብሰ-ጡር እናቶች ፣ ጨቅላዎች እና ህጻናት ይገኙበታል ። ሜደስን ሳንስ ፍሮንቲርስ የሳምባምች ታማሚዎችን እና በነዳጅ ፍሳሽ ምክንያት ቆዳቸው የተቃጠሉ ሰዎችን አክሚያለው ብሏል ። ባለፉት 9 ወራት ብቻ ከ1500 ስደተኞች በላይ ሜዲትራኒያን ባህርን ለማቋረጥ ጥረት ሲያደርጉ ህይወታቸው ማለፉን ዓለም አቀፉ የስደተኞች ተቋም ገልጿል ።<|im_end|>

language: Amharic (amh)
text: ባለሥልጣኑ ይህን ድርጊት አልፈፀምኩም በማለት የእምነት ክህደት ቃላቸውን ሰጥተዋል ። የሻሮን ኦቲየኖ ሬሳ ጫካ ውስጥ ከተገኘ በኋላ ነው ሁኔታው ወደ ፍርድ ቤት እንዲቀርብ ከበርካቶች ጫና መበርታት የጀመረው ። • ቻይናዊው በዘረኛ ንግግሩ ምክንያት ከሃገር ሊባረር ነው የአስከሬን ምርመራው እንዳረጋገጠው የ26 ዓመቷ ሻሮን ተደፍራ እና በስለት 8 ቦታ ተወግታ ነው የተገኘችው ፤ ሽሉም በጥቃቱ ጊዜ ሕይወቱ እንዳለፈ ተረጋግጧል ። ሚጎሪ የተሰኘው የኬንያ ግዛት አስተዳዳተሪ የሆኑት እኚህ ግለሰብ በፖሊስ ቁጥጥር ሥር የሚገኙ ሲሆን ክሱ ወደ ፍርድ ቤት ተልኳል ። የፍርድ ቤቱ ዳኛ ባልሥልጣኑ ብቻ ሳይሆኑ ሁለት አጋሮቻቸው በቁጥጥር ሥር እንዲውሉ አዘዋል ፤ አንዱ በግድያ ሌላኛው ደግሞ በማስተባበር ወንጀል ተጠርጥረው ። አቃቤ ሕግ ሻሮን እና ሃገረ ገዢ ኦባዶ የፍቅር ግንኙነት እንደነበራቸው አረጋግጫለሁ ብሎ እርግዝናው ግን ያልተፈለገ ነው ፤ በተለይ ደግሞ በተጠርጣሪ በኩል ሲል አክሏል ። • ጉግል ኢንተርኔትን በላስቲክ ከረጢት ይዞ ኬንያ ገብቷል የሟች እና የተጠርጣሪው ኦባዶ ግንኙነት ሃገር ያወቀው ፤ ፀሐይ የሞቀው ነው በተለይ ደግሞ ባለሥልጣኑ በሚያስተዳድሩት አካባቢ ሲል አቃቤ ሕግ ጉዳዩን አብራርቷል ። የሃገር ገዢው ኦባዶ ባለቤት የባላቸውን ከትዳር ውጭ የተመሠረት ግንኙት እያወቁት ባለሥልጣኑ ይህን ድርጊት መፈፀማቸው ደግሞ ክሱን ያከብደዋል ይላል አቃቤ ሕግ ። በርካታ ኬንያዊያንን ያስቆጣው ይህ ድርጊት በቅርብ ቀን ፍርድ ያገኛል ተብሎ ይጠበቃል ። • ኬንያ ሺሻን አገደች
ኦኮት ኦባዶ የተባሉት ኬንያዊ ከፍተኛ ባለሥልጣን ከትዳራቸው ውጪ ግንኙነት የነበራቸውን ነብሰጡር ጓደኛቸውን በጭካኔ እንድትገደል አዘዋል እንዲሁም አስተባብረዋል በሚል ክስ ቀርቦባቸዋል ።

ኦኮት ኦባዶ የተባሉት ኬንያዊ ከፍተኛ ባለሥልጣን ከትዳራቸው ውጪ ግንኙነት የነበራቸውን ነብሰጡር ጓደኛቸውን በጭካኔ እንድትገደል አዘዋል እንዲሁም አስተባብረዋል በሚል ክስ ቀርቦባቸዋል ።

language: Hausa (hau)
text: Haaland yana son barin Dortmund a bazarar nan kuma ya matsu ya tafi Real Madrid . ( ABC - in Spanish ) Manchester United na sha'awar daukar dan wasann Barcelona dan asalin kasar Guniea da ke buga gasar ' yan kasa da shekara 17 a Sifaniya Ilaix Moriba , mai shekara 18 . ( Mundo Deportivo - in Spanish ) Paris St-Germain ta shirya sabunta kwangilar dan wasan Faransar Kylian Mbappe , mai shekara 22 , inda za ta ba shi euro 30m ( £25 . 8m ) domin hana Real Madrid da Liverpool daukarsa . ( L'Equipe via Mirror ) Barcelona na son daukar dan wasan Manchester City da Argentina Sergio Aguero , mai shekara 32 , da kuma dan kwallon Liverpool dan kasar Netherlands Georginio Wijnaldum , mai shekara 30 , a lokacin musayar ' yan kwallo na bazara . ( AS via Sport Witness ) Juventus na ci gaba da sanya ido kan halin da dan wasan Manchester United Paul Pogba yake ciki , a yayin da kwangilar dan wasan na Faransa mai shekara 28 za ta kare a watan Yunin 2022 . ( Calciomercato - in Italian ) Tottenham za ta yi asarar £25m idan ta sallami kocinta Jose Mourinho daga aiki . ( Mirror ) Barcelona za ta bai wa dan wasan Argentina Lionel Messi , mai shekara 33 , kwangila ta tsawon rayuwarsa a bazarar nan a yunkurin da take yi na hana shi barin kungiyar amma za ta nemi ya amince a rage albashinsa . ( Mundo Deportivo - in Spanish ) Har yanzu West Ham ba ta tattauna game da sayen dan wasan Manchester United da Ingila Jesse Lingard , baki daya ba . Dan wasan mai 28 yana zaman aro a kungiyar . ( Football London ) Napoli na sha'awar dan wasan Liverpool dan kasar Girka Kostas Tsimikas , mai shekara 24 , wanda sau shida kawai ya murza leda tun da ya je kungiyar a bazarar da ta wuce . ( Corriere dello Sport via Sport Witness ) Liverpool da Tottenham sun bayyana sha'awarsu ta daukar dan wasan Amurka Matthew Hoppe , mai shekara 20 , daga Schalke . ( Transfermarkt - in German ) Ana duba yiwuwar nada tsohon kocin Juventus Massimiliano Allegri a matsayin kocin Napoli domin ya maye gurbin Gennaro Gattuso . ( Calciomercato - in Italian )

Real Madrid da Barcelona sun shirya gogayya da Manchester City , Manchester United da kuma Chelsea a yunkurin daukar dan wasan Borussia Dortmund da Norway Erling Braut Haaland , mai shekara 20 . ( AS - in Spanish )

language: Rundi (run)
text: Perezida Hassan Rouhani yavuze ko politike ya Perezida Trump ari iy'umuntu uhangayitse Perezida Hassan Rouhani yavuze ko ingamba Bwana Trump yafatiye umutegetsi w'ikirenga wa Irani ku munsi w'ejo ku wa mbere ' ntacyo zimaze ' ndetse yamagana imigambi y'Amerika yo gufatira ibihano minisitiri w'ububanyi n'amahanga wa Irani . Bwana Rouhani yavuze ko izo ngamba zigaragaza ko ibiro bya White House bya Perezida w'Amerika ' birwaye mu mutwe ' . Bwana Trump yavuze ko ibyo bihano bishya bigamije kwihimura ku ' myitwarire y'ubushotoranyi ' ya Irani . Ni bande bandi bafatiwe ibihano ? Amerika ivuga ko yafatiye ibihano bishya bikomeye ibiro by'umutegetsi w'ikirenga w'iki gihugu Ali Khamenei ivuga ko ' ari we wo kuryozwa imyitwarire y'ubushotoranyi y'ubutegetsi [ bwa Irani ] ' . Ibiro by'imari by'Amerika byatangaje ko abakuru umunani b'umutwe kabuhariwe w'igirikare cya Irani na bo bafatiwe ibihano kubera ' ibikorwa bibi by'uwo mutwe mu karere ' . Steve Mnuchin , umukuru w'ibiro by'imari by'Amerika , yavuze ko ibyo bihano bizafatira umutungo wa Irani ubarirwa muri za ' miliyari ' z'amadolari y'Amerika . Yavuze ko itegeko-teka rya Bwana Trump rikubiyemo ibyo bihano ' rizabuza ubutegetsi bwa Irani kubona imari yo kwifashisha ' . Iri tegeko ' ritanga uruhushya rwo kwibasira abantu bashyirwa mu mwanya kanaka cyangwa indi myanya n'umutegetsi w'ikirenga cyangwa ibiro by'umutegetsi w'ikirenga ' . Bwana Mnuchin yongeyeho ko na Javad Zarif , Minisitiri w'ububanyi n'amahanga wa Irani , azafatirwa ibihano mu mpera y'iki cyumweru . Mu byumweru bicye bishize , umwuka mubi wakomeje gututumba hagati y'ibihugu byombi . Akanama k'umutekano k'umuryango w'abibumbye kasabye impande zombi gutuza no gukoresha inzira y'ibiganiro .

text: Perezida Hassan Rouhani yavuze ko politike ya Perezida Trump ari iy'umuntu uhangayitse Perezida Hassan Rouhani yavuze ko ingamba Bwana Trump yafatiye umutegetsi w'ikirenga wa Irani ku munsi w'ejo ku wa mbere ' ntacyo zimaze ' ndetse yamagana imigambi y'Amerika yo gufatira ibihano minisitiri w'ububanyi n'amahanga wa Irani . language: Igbo (ibo)
text: Onyeisi ọgbakọ ndị gọvanọ ọwụwaanyanwụ bụ David Umahi kwuputere nke a mgbe ọ na-agwa ndị ntaakụkọ ka nzụkọ ha nwere n'elu intanet si gaa n'ụlọ gọọmenti dị na Abakaliki . Lee ihe ndị ọzọ pụtara n'ọgbakọ ahụ : 1 . Umahi kwuru na ha tulere etu ọrịa coronavirus si metụta mpaghara ọwụwaanyanwụ ma na - - ekwu na ha ga-atụle ihe gbasara ụlọakwụkwọ iji kwado atụmaatụ nile Nigeria Centre for Disease Control ( NCDC ) wepụtara wee na-eche mgbe a ga-emepe ụlọakwụkwọ . 2 . Mpaghara ọwụwaanyanwụ niile ga-amalite ime nyocha n'ụlọ n'ụlọ tụmadị ndị ruru ma gafee afọ iri isii na ise . 3 . Ha rịọrọ ka onye bụbụ odeakwụkwọ gọọmenti Naịjiria , Anyim Pius Anyim na Arthur Eze bụ ide ji ego kwụsị esemokwu dị n'etiti ha ma kwe ka ndị gọvanọ ọwụwaanyanwụ dozie okwu na-esere ha . Ihe na-esere ha abụọ 4 . Ha kelere onyeisiala Buhari ka o si wete ego eji arụ akwa mmiri Naịja nke abụọ nakwa ndozi ọdọ ụgbọelu Enugu . 5 . Ha kwetere na a ga-emeperiri ọdọ ụgbọelu Enugu n'ụbọchị iri atọ nke ọnwa Ọgọstụ ma rụcha akwa mmiri abụọ nke Niger n'afọ 2022 . 6 . Ha kwetere na ha ga-akpọpụta aha ngalaba nchekwa ọhụru ga-echekwa mpaghara ọwụwaanyanwụ nile n'ọgbakọ ọzọ ha ga-enwe . 7 . Ha kwetere na ha na gọọmenti etiti ga-etikọta aka wepụta ego a ga-eji rụ ụgbọ oloko ga-erute mpaghara ọwụwaanyanwụ . Ihe pụtara na nzuko ndị gọvanọ ọwụwanyanwụ n'Enugwu n'ọnwa Febrụwarị Ndị gọvanọ na-achị mpaghara ọwụwanyanwụ nke Naịjirịa nwere nzukọ n'Enugwu Steeti taa . Ozi a si n'aka gọvanọ na-achị Enugwu Steeti bụ Ifeanyi Ugwuanyi bụ onye lere ha ọbịa n'obi ọchịchị ya dị n'Enugwu . Ndị so n'ọgbakọ ha gụnyere gọvanọ Dave Umahi nke Ebonyi , gọvanọ Okezie Ikpeazu nke Abia na osote gọvanọ Anambra bụ Nkem Okeke . Ndị ọzọ bụ ọkanmụta Barth Nnaji , onyeisi ọgbakọ ha bụ ọkanmụta Simon Ortuanya na ndị ọzọ . Dịka ọ dị ugbua , amabeghi ihe ha kpatara na nzukọ a . Akụkọ ndị ọzọ ga-amasị gị : Nwada Igbo chọtara ihu ọma n'aka gọvanọ Borno Steeti Gọvanọ Borno steeti na Obiageli Mazi mgbe ọ jere njem nleta mberede Gọvanọ Borno steeti bụ Babagana Zulum ajaala Obiageli Mazi mma na ndụ maka uchu na mbọ ọ na agba n'ọrụ nkuzi ya . Gọvanọ ahụ mere njem mberede n'ụlọakwụkwọ ya bụ nwaanyi n'isi ụtụtụ Fraịde were zute naanị ya n'ọrụ n'elekere isii nke ụtụtụ . Gọvanọ buliri ya n'ọkwa ma nyekwa nwaego mmachiakpa . Ihe ndị mmadụ na-ekwu maka atụmaatụ a n'elu soshal midia USER kwuru na etu a esi gosipụta atụmaatụ a nwereike itinye ndụ nwaanyị a na nsogbu . USER na-eto gọvanọ Borno maka obioma ya . USER na-eto onye nkuzi a maka etu o si nọrọ na-agba mbọ na steeti ahụ agbanyeghị ụfọdụ mmekpa ahụ na-eme ebe ahụ . USER kwuru na ọ bụ etu Naịjirịa kwesiri , nihi na ekwesighị nwe nkewa . Ndị ụka Metọdisti emeela ngagharịiwe Ndị ụka Metọdisti nke Naịjirịa emeela ngagharịiwe megide oke ogbugbu a na-egbu ndị mmadụ na Naịjirịa karịsịa ndị ụka Kraịst . Ọ bụ ụka Metọdisti nke ngalaba Opebi dị n'Ikeja nke Legọs Steeti mere nke a . Cheta n'izuụka gara aga , na onyeisi ụka Redeemed bụ Pastọ Adeboye na ndị ụka ya mere otu ngagharịiwe a n'ihi nchekwa na Naịjirịa . Atụọla ndị agha gburu mmadụ nga Ụlọikpe ndị agha Naịjirịa amaala mmadụ atọ ndị otu ha ikpe afọ iri maka iji arụrụala rụgbụọ onye otu ha . Majors Oseni , Ogbemudia Osawe , Captain Amosu na Second Lieutenant Nuhu Dogary gburu Bejamine Collins n'afọ 2017 . Egburu ndị agha Amerika abụọ N'ofesi , ndị agha mba Amerika ekwuola na egburu ndị agha ha mmadụ abụọ ma meruo isii ahụ na ọwụwa anyanwụ mba Afganistan . Ọnụ na-ekwuru ndị agha Amerika ebe ahụ bụ Sonny Leggett sị na onye mere ihe a yi akwa ndị agha Afganistan kpọpere mgbo ebe ndị agha ndị ọzọ nọ . Shieffield na Bournemouth Onye egwu Sander Berge bụ onye Shielffield United gotere ọhụrụ akwadowela egwu mbụ ya N'egwuregwu , Sheffield United ga-ezute ndị Bournemouth n'elekere abụọ nke ehihie a na asọmpị premier league . Gee akọkọ ndị n'otu nkeji Akụkọ ga-amasị gị ị ga-achọ ikọ taa niile Bishop Chukwuma etinyela ọnụ n'okwu Archi Bishop ndị Anglikan nke Enugu bụ Emmanuel Chukwuma ekwuola na kepu kepu a juru sosha media kemgbe na gọọmenti Enugu steeti ruru ụlọ ndị Alakụba bụ ọkpụrụ kpụrụ asi . Chukwuma sị ndị na-agbasa ya bụ asiri wepụ aka enwe n'ofe tupu ọ ghọọ aka mmadụ . ' Ụmụnwaanyị bụ ndị na-ejekarị ebe a na-eburu ha amụma ' - Bishop Chukwuma Fashola sị na iji mmadụ gwọọ ọgwụ ego anaghị arụ ọrụ Minista na-ahụ maka ọrụ na ụlọ , Babatunde Fashola ekwuola na iji mmadụ gwọọ ogwuego adịdghị ire ma rịọ ndị na-eme ihe nkiri ha ejizina ya eme ihe nkiri . Fashola kwuru nke a n'ọgbakọ ekpokobara maka nchekwa obodo ebe ọ nọ sị ndị ọnụ na-eru n'okwu kawa ahụ gwa ndị mmadụ nke bụ eziokwu . Agbagbuola onye gburu ndị mmadụ na Thai Land N'ofesi , ndị ọrụ nchekwa egbuola ya bụ onye agha gburu onyeisi ya nakwa mmadụ iri abụọ na Thai Land . Odobeghị anya ihe mere Jakraphanth Thomma jiri kpaa udi agwa ahụ mana Minista ahuike mba ahụ kelere ndị ọrụnchekwa maka ịkwụsị ya bụ nwoke . Raheem Sterling agaghị eso gbaa bọọlụ ndị West Ham N'egwuregwu , Manchester City ga-ezute West Ham taa na ọgbọegwuregwu ha bụ Etihad . Onyeegwu ha bụ Raheem Sterling agaghị eso gbaa maka ahụ o meruru mgbe ha na Tottenham gbara bọọlụ n'izuụka gara aga . Gee akụkọ ndị n'otu nkeji Akụkọ ga-amasị gị ị ga-achọ ikọ taa niile

Gee akọkọ ndị n'otu nkeji Akụkọ ga-amasị gị ị ga-achọ ikọ taa niile Bishop Chukwuma etinyela ọnụ n'okwu Archi Bishop ndị Anglikan nke Enugu bụ Emmanuel Chukwuma ekwuola na kepu kepu a juru sosha media kemgbe na gọọmenti Enugu steeti ruru ụlọ ndị Alakụba bụ ọkpụrụ kpụrụ asi . Chukwuma sị ndị na-agbasa ya bụ asiri wepụ aka enwe n'ofe tupu ọ ghọọ aka mmadụ . ' Ụmụnwaanyị bụ ndị na-ejekarị ebe a na-eburu ha amụma ' - Bishop Chukwuma Fashola sị na iji mmadụ gwọọ ọgwụ ego anaghị arụ ọrụ Minista na-ahụ maka ọrụ na ụlọ , Babatunde Fashola ekwuola na iji mmadụ gwọọ ogwuego adịdghị ire ma rịọ ndị na-eme ihe nkiri ha ejizina ya eme ihe nkiri . Fashola kwuru nke a n'ọgbakọ ekpokobara maka nchekwa obodo ebe ọ nọ sị ndị ọnụ na-eru n'okwu kawa ahụ gwa ndị mmadụ nke bụ eziokwu . Odobeghị anya ihe mere Jakraphanth Thomma jiri kpaa udi agwa ahụ mana Minista ahuike mba ahụ kelere ndị ọrụnchekwa maka ịkwụsị ya bụ nwoke . Raheem Sterling agaghị eso gbaa bọọlụ ndị West Ham N'egwuregwu , Manchester City ga-ezute West Ham taa na ọgbọegwuregwu ha bụ Etihad . language: Igbo (ibo)
text: Mmiri so n'ime ihe ndị kachasị mkpa n'ụwa nke mere ndị otu ' United Nations General Assembly ' ji kpebie n'ọnwa Jụlaị nke afọ 2010 na ịnweta mmiri so n'ikike dịrị onye nke Bekee kpọrọ ' human right ' . A kpọrọ ikike a ' Human Rights to Water and Sanitation ' ( HWS ) . N'agbanyeghị na Naịjirịa so n'ime mba ndị binyere aka n'ikike a , na otụtụ steeti ọkachasị nke ọwụwa anyanwụ , ndị mmadụ amaghị ihe bụ na mmiri na-agba n'ụlọ nke ha ji a ma na ọ bụ gọọmentị ka ọdịịrị inye ha mmiri . Na steeti Anambara , Enugwu , Ebonyị , Imo na Abịa , ndị ha na BBC Igbo kparịtara ụka sị na ha amaghịdị ihe bụ na mmiri na-agba na igwe mmiri gọọmentị . Otu onye bi Enugwu sị na o ruola afọ iri mmiri gbadebere na mpaghara ya bi n'Enugwu . Ọtụtụ mmadu ka na-echu mmiri n'iyi di ka nke a dị n'obodo Nkwe , n'okpuru ọchịchị Ọgwụ , Steeti Enugwu N'Anambara Ọ bụ n'ọchịchi Chinwoke Mbadinuju ka mmiri gbara na pọmpụ n'Ọka ikpeazu . Uche Nwonwu bụ nwata akwụkwọ na Mahadum Nnamdi Azikiwe sị na ebe ha bi n'Ọka enweghị mmiri ma ncha . Ọ sị na ' ọ bụ mmiri ndị mmadụ gbapere na be ha ka ha na-aṅụkarị . ' Mmiri gọọmentị kwa ụbọchị ụka Nwaada Nwonwu sị na enwere nnukwu tankị mmiri gọọmentị tinyere n'Ifite Ọka na-agba sọsọ ụbọchị ụka . Dịka o si kọwa ; ' Ọ bụ n'ụbọchị ụka , ma ọkụ larịk dị , ka a na-agbanye mmiri n'ebe ahụ . ' Ọ na-amalite n'elekere asatọ nke ụtụtụ , a gbachie ya n'elekere abụọ nke ehihe . O na-abụkwa sọsọ oge ọkụ dị ka nke a na-eme . ' Mgbe ọzọ , ọ na-abu site n'ihe Bekee na-akpọ ' bore hole ' ka ndị mmadụ si enwete mmiri . Otu ihe a na-emekwa na mpaghara niile na steeti Anambara . N'Enugwu Ọ bụ sọsọ n'ụfọdụ mpaghara isi obodo Enugwu steeti ka ndị mmadụ na-ahụ mmiri si n'aka gọọmentị . Emeka Ike bụ onye ọrụ Bekee gwara BBC Igbo na ọ na-ete ezigbote aka tupu mmiri si n'aka gọọmentị agbaa n'Enugwu nke mere ka ọtụtụ mmadụ na-echu mmiri n'awa mmiri , na ' bore hole ' maọbu na tanka na-ere mmiri . Ọ sị ; ' Ndị tanka a na-esi 9th mile egote mmiri ha na-eresi ndi mmadụ . ' Iyiọcha Nkwe Maazị Ike sị na mmiri so n'ihe kachasị enye nsogbu n'Enugwu . Ka ọ kwụ ugbua , ọ bụdị sọsọ obodo Enugwu ka enwere isi mmiri gọọmentị na-agbanyeghị na nke dị adị achịtaghịdi aja ma ncha . N'Imo Paul Chukwu bụ onye ntaakụko gwara BBC Igbo na ọ bụ kemgbe ọchịchi Ikedi Ohakim ka mmiri gbasọrọ n'Owere . Dịka o sị kwuo ; ' Ọ bụghị na mmiri na-agbabu ọfụma na mbụ , mana ọ kwụsịrị kpamkpam n'ime afọ asato Rochas Okorocha chịrị ' Maazị Chukwu sị na gọọmentị ọhụrụ n'Imo na-ekwuzi okwu ime ka mmirị malite ịgba ọzọ mana ọ ka bu okwu ka ha na-ekwu . Kelechi Enyoghasim bụ nwata akwụkwọ n'Owere sị na ọ bụ na ' borehole ' ka ha si enweta mmiri . Ọ sị na ya amaghị etu mmiri gọọmentị na-adị . O kwukwara na , ' anyị nwere ' borehole ' . Ọ bụ ebe ahu ka anyị si agbata mmiri . ' ' Ọ na-abụkarị na ndi mmadụ na-arụ ụlọ na-egwu bore hole n'ime ya . Ndị mmadụ adịghị ele gọọmentị anya . ' N'Abịa World Water Day 2020 : Anyị enweghi mmiri ọṅụṅụ n'obodo Ezeukwu-Alayi N'Aba Chidi Ikeh gwara BBC Igbo na onweghi ihe dị ka mmiri gọọmentị na-agba n'igwe n'obodo ahụ nke o ji adị na steeti Abịa niile . Ọ sị , ' Ọ bụkwa ' borehole ' ka ndị mmadụ ji enyere onwe ha aka . ' ' Ihe anyị ma si n'aka ndị omeiwu bụkwa ' borehole ' mana ọ dịghị arụ ọrụ ọfụma . ' Ihe mmiri ha na-adịkarị n'ime nnukwu tanka na-eji igwe ọku arụ ọrụ . Ha emechiela . ' N'Ebonyi Ebe a na-ere mmiri Dịka Obinna Udenwe bụ onye ode akwụkwọ nakwa onye ndọrọndọrọ ọchịchị siri gwa BBC Igbo , Ebonyi steeti nweburu mmiri gọọmentị na-agba n'Abakiliki ruo pacentị 30 tupu Martin Elechi amalite ọrụ mmiri na Oferekpe na Ukawu . ' Martin Elechi rụru ọrụ mmiri a ruo Abakiliki . Ihe fọrọ bụ ka ewere igwe mmiri tinye n'ụlọ ndị mmadụ . Mana kemgbe aka na-achị steeti a ugbua bụ Dave Umahi bịara , ọrụ a kwụsịrị , ' MaazỊ Udenwe kwuru . Ọ gakwara n'ihu kwuo na ezigbote ego banyere na ụrọ mmiri a nke mere o jiri dị mkpa ka arụcha ya . Ọ sị na ọ bụ na bore ka ndị mmadụ na-echu mmiri . Maazị udenwe sị ; ' Ọ bụ na ' roundabout ka anyị na ahụ mmiri gọọmentị . Abịa a gbape mmiri bore a ga-eji na-enye ' water fountain ' mmiri . Ya bịazịa ọ dị ka mmiri a na-agba n'Ebonyi . ' Inwe agbọ mmiri bụ ihe ọtụtụ mmadu na-eme iji nyere onwe ha aka maka ọkọ mmiri Ọnọdụ a ọ ga-abịa na njedebe na nso nso a ? N'ọnwa Maachị nke afọ 2019 , onye bụbụ Kọmịshọna na-ahụ maka ihe Bekee kpọrọ ' Public Utilities ' na steeti Abịa gwara ndị ntaakụkọ na gọọmentị Abịa na ngalaba enyemaka mba Amerịka akpọrọ ' United States Agency for International Development ' ( USAID ) na-akpa nkata iji hu na igwe mmiri kpọchara nkụ gbara mmiri ọzọ . Ọ sịkwa na gọọmentị Abịa na-achụkwa nta ibite ego n'aka otu ụlọakụ dị na mba Belgịọm maka okwu mmiri a . Abịa sọ n'ime steeti isii USAID họpụtara maka atụmatụ a na Naịjirịa . Mana ndị gwara BBC Igbo okwu na steeti ahụ sị na onwebeghị ihe ha hụrụ . Enugwu nwere atụmatu ha kpọrọ ' Oji River Water Scheme ' , mana dịka ihe di n'ala gosiri , atụmatụ a adịghị enye ndị Enugwu mmiri ha chọrọ . Akwa ụzọ Nkwe na Ezere Kọmịshọna ha-ahụ maka mgbasaozi n'Enugwu bụ Chidi Iroh sị na ọ bụ ọkụ bụ isiokwu ha nwere n'atụmatu ịhụ na ndị Enugwu nwere mmiri . ỌỊ sị , ' Anyị nwere ebe esi enwete mmiri n'Ajali nakwa Oji River . Anyị nwekwara ebe ' borehole ' juputara na Ngwo nakwa Nsude . ' Kemgbe gọọmenti anyị bịara , anyị mere ka mmiri n'erute Enugwu si ihe Bekee kpọrọ ' cubic metres ' puku ise ruo puku iri . ' Ọ sịkwa na ihe ha chọrọ bụ ka o ruo cubic metre otu puku narị na iri abụọ . Ọ sịkwa na ha nwere atụmatu enyemaka banyere mmiri si aka ụlọ aka mmepe mba Frans . Kọmịshọna mgbasaozi n'Amambara steeti bụ Don Adinuba sị na ọ bụ Kọmịshọna na-ahụ maka ' Utilities ' nwere okwu a , mana BBC enweteghi ekwenti ya . Etu a ka ọ dịkwa na nke Ebonyi steeti . Nke bu eziokwu bụ n'agbanyeghi ihe gọọmentị niile a na-eme , ọrụ dị ka bụ atụrụ tawa .

' N'Abịa World Water Day 2020 : Anyị enweghi mmiri ọṅụṅụ n'obodo Ezeukwu-Alayi N'Aba Chidi Ikeh gwara BBC Igbo na onweghi ihe dị ka mmiri gọọmentị na-agba n'igwe n'obodo ahụ nke o ji adị na steeti Abịa niile . Ọ sị , ' Ọ bụkwa ' borehole ' ka ndị mmadụ ji enyere onwe ha aka . ' ' Ihe anyị ma si n'aka ndị omeiwu bụkwa ' borehole ' mana ọ dịghị arụ ọrụ ọfụma . ' Ihe mmiri ha na-adịkarị n'ime nnukwu tanka na-eji igwe ọku arụ ọrụ . Ha emechiela . ' N'Ebonyi Ebe a na-ere mmiri Dịka Obinna Udenwe bụ onye ode akwụkwọ nakwa onye ndọrọndọrọ ọchịchị siri gwa BBC Igbo , Ebonyi steeti nweburu mmiri gọọmentị na-agba n'Abakiliki ruo pacentị 30 tupu Martin Elechi amalite ọrụ mmiri na Oferekpe na Ukawu . ' Martin Elechi rụru ọrụ mmiri a ruo Abakiliki . Ihe fọrọ bụ ka ewere igwe mmiri tinye n'ụlọ ndị mmadụ . Mana kemgbe aka na-achị steeti a ugbua bụ Dave Umahi bịara , ọrụ a kwụsịrị , ' MaazỊ Udenwe kwuru . Ọ gakwara n'ihu kwuo na ezigbote ego banyere na ụrọ mmiri a nke mere o jiri dị mkpa ka arụcha ya . Ọ sị na ọ bụ na bore ka ndị mmadụ na-echu mmiri . Maazị udenwe sị ; ' Ọ bụ na ' roundabout ka anyị na ahụ mmiri gọọmentị . Abịa a gbape mmiri bore a ga-eji na-enye ' water fountain ' mmiri . Ya bịazịa ọ dị ka mmiri a na-agba n'Ebonyi . ' Inwe agbọ mmiri bụ ihe ọtụtụ mmadu na-eme iji nyere onwe ha aka maka ọkọ mmiri Ọnọdụ a ọ ga-abịa na njedebe na nso nso a ? N'ọnwa Maachị nke afọ 2019 , onye bụbụ Kọmịshọna na-ahụ maka ihe Bekee kpọrọ ' Public Utilities ' na steeti Abịa gwara ndị ntaakụkọ na gọọmentị Abịa na ngalaba enyemaka mba Amerịka akpọrọ ' United States Agency for International Development ' ( USAID ) na-akpa nkata iji hu na igwe mmiri kpọchara nkụ gbara mmiri ọzọ . Ọ sịkwa na gọọmentị Abịa na-achụkwa nta ibite ego n'aka otu ụlọakụ dị na mba Belgịọm maka okwu mmiri a . Abịa sọ n'ime steeti isii USAID họpụtara maka atụmatụ a na Naịjirịa . Mana ndị gwara BBC Igbo okwu na steeti ahụ sị na onwebeghị ihe ha hụrụ . Enugwu nwere atụmatu ha kpọrọ ' Oji River Water Scheme ' , mana dịka ihe di n'ala gosiri , atụmatụ a adịghị enye ndị Enugwu mmiri ha chọrọ . Akwa ụzọ Nkwe na Ezere Kọmịshọna ha-ahụ maka mgbasaozi n'Enugwu bụ Chidi Iroh sị na ọ bụ ọkụ bụ isiokwu ha nwere n'atụmatu ịhụ na ndị Enugwu nwere mmiri . ỌỊ sị , ' Anyị nwere ebe esi enwete mmiri n'Ajali nakwa Oji River . Anyị nwekwara ebe ' borehole ' juputara na Ngwo nakwa Nsude . ' Kemgbe gọọmenti anyị bịara , anyị mere ka mmiri n'erute Enugwu si ihe Bekee kpọrọ ' cubic metres ' puku ise ruo puku iri . ' Ọ sịkwa na ihe ha chọrọ bụ ka o ruo cubic metre otu puku narị na iri abụọ . Ọ sịkwa na ha nwere atụmatu enyemaka banyere mmiri si aka ụlọ aka mmepe mba Frans . Kọmịshọna mgbasaozi n'Amambara steeti bụ Don Adinuba sị na ọ bụ Kọmịshọna na-ahụ maka ' Utilities ' nwere okwu a , mana BBC enweteghi ekwenti ya . Etu a ka ọ dịkwa na nke Ebonyi steeti . Nke bu eziokwu bụ n'agbanyeghi ihe gọọmentị niile a na-eme , ọrụ dị ka bụ atụrụ tawa .<|im_end|>

text: Haaland yana son barin Dortmund a bazarar nan kuma ya matsu ya tafi Real Madrid . language: Somali (som)
text: Dadka ka faallooda arrimahan waxay tartanka doorashada Mareykanka ku tilmaameen sida ' dagaal weyn ' , halka kuwa kalena ay ka digayaan astaamo muujinaya ' xiisad siyaasadeed ' oo ka dhalata Mareykanka , gaar ahaan , sida ay tiro ahaan isugu dhow yihiin Donald Trump iyo ninka ay tartamayaan ee xisbiga Dimuqraadiga , Joe Biden , oo gobollada qaar wacdaro ka dhigay . Dagaalkii Tom iyo Jerry Wargeyska dalka Sacuudiga ka soo baxa , ee Al-Riyad , ayaa doorashada Mareykanka ee 2020 - ka ku tilmaamay ' doorashadii ugu layaabka badneyd , uguna xiisaha badnayd , ee ka dhacda dalka Mareykanka ' . Wargeyska ayaa muujiyay in ay dhici kartay in ' doorashadan ay baabi'in doonto dhammaan jidadka sharciga ah ee suurtogalka ah , ka hor inta aan natiijada kama dambaysta ah la soo saarin ama xisbiyadu aqbalin , sababtoo ah jawiga doorashadu waa mid kacsan oo murashaxiintuna waxayba bilaabeen inay su'aal ka keenaan hannaanka geeddi-socodka doorashooyinka xilli hore ' . Cabdalla Al-Salam ayaa ku qoray wargayska ka soo baxa dalka Masar ee Al-Ahram sidaan : ' Illaa iyo inta ay runta ka imaaneyso , oo aan ka ogaaneyno cida noqon doonta madaxweynaha xiga ee Mareykanka , waxaan goob joog u noqon doonnaa khilaaf weyn , askarta hardameysana waxay noqon doonaan boqolaal qareeno ah , sidoo kale jeneraallada dagaalkan waa siyaasiyiinta xisbiyada , iyo hogaamiyayaashooda Trump iyo Biden . ' ' Sidoo kale , inta arrimahan socdaan lagama hadli doono arrimo ay ka mid yihiin karoonaha iyo Shiinaha - Tom iyo Jerry way dagaalami doonaan waxaan ula jeedaa Trump iyo Biden ' , ayuu yiri . Sidoo kale wargeyska saldhigiisu yahay magaalada London ee dalka Ingiriiska laguna magacaabo Al - Carabiya Al jadiid , ayaa sheegay in iyadoo Biden uu ku dhowyahay in uu guul ka gaaro doorashada oo waliba uu ku kalsoonyahay ay haddana arrintaas Mareykanka u tahay marxalad cusub , marka la eego xiisaha doorashada iyo loollanka adag ee la galay . Wargeyska AL Akhbaar ee ka soo baxa dalka Lubnaan ayaa isna sheegay in Mareykanku uu wajahayo ' xiisad siyaasadeed oo mas'uliyadeeda uu leeyahay madaxweweyne Donald Trump ' . Qalalaasaha siyaasadeed ee dhanka garsoorka Iyadoo Trump uu wacad ku maray inuu tagayo maxkamadda si uu uga hor-tago sharci ahaanta waraaqaha cod-bixinta ee boostada , ayaa haddana wargayska London ka soo baxa ee Al-Quds Al-Arabi uu qoray in ' jahwareerkan ' siyaasadeed uu isu rogi karo ' xiisad weyn oo xagga garsoorka ah , haddii Donald Trump uu fuliyo ballanqaadkiisa ahaa in uu maxakamad aadayo . ' Si kastaba ha noqatee natiijadaan waxay horseedi kartaa dacwad ka dhan ah codbixinta iyo hannaanka tirinta codadka ee gobollada muhiimka ah . Waxaana Kiisas laga xareeyay gobollo gaar ah . Wargeyska Al-Carab ee ka soo baxa magaalada London ayaa sidoo kale is waydiiyay su'aashaan : ' Doorashada Mareykanka ma waxaa lagu go'aamin doonaa qolka maxkamadda ? ' Wargeyska Al Sharqul Qadariya , ayaa isana meesha ka saaray in Biden ama Trump midkoodna uu quusan doono haddii midkood looga adkaado doorashada . ' Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriga - waa Trump ee - wuxuu had iyo jeer sheegaa in codeynta boostada ay sahlayso wax isdabamarin ballaaran . '

text: Dadka ka faallooda arrimahan waxay tartanka doorashada Mareykanka ku tilmaameen sida ' dagaal weyn ' , halka kuwa kalena ay ka digayaan astaamo muujinaya ' xiisad siyaasadeed ' oo ka dhalata Mareykanka , gaar ahaan , sida ay tiro ahaan isugu dhow yihiin Donald Trump iyo ninka ay tartamayaan ee xisbiga Dimuqraadiga , Joe Biden , oo gobollada qaar wacdaro ka dhigay . Dagaalkii Tom iyo Jerry Wargeyska dalka Sacuudiga ka soo baxa , ee Al-Riyad , ayaa doorashada Mareykanka ee 2020 - ka ku tilmaamay ' doorashadii ugu layaabka badneyd , uguna xiisaha badnayd , ee ka dhacda dalka Mareykanka ' . Wargeyska ayaa muujiyay in ay dhici kartay in ' doorashadan ay baabi'in doonto dhammaan jidadka sharciga ah ee suurtogalka ah , ka hor inta aan natiijada kama dambaysta ah la soo saarin ama xisbiyadu aqbalin , sababtoo ah jawiga doorashadu waa mid kacsan oo murashaxiintuna waxayba bilaabeen inay su'aal ka keenaan hannaanka geeddi-socodka doorashooyinka xilli hore ' . Cabdalla Al-Salam ayaa ku qoray wargayska ka soo baxa dalka Masar ee Al-Ahram sidaan : ' Illaa iyo inta ay runta ka imaaneyso , oo aan ka ogaaneyno cida noqon doonta madaxweynaha xiga ee Mareykanka , waxaan goob joog u noqon doonnaa khilaaf weyn , askarta hardameysana waxay noqon doonaan boqolaal qareeno ah , sidoo kale jeneraallada dagaalkan waa siyaasiyiinta xisbiyada , iyo hogaamiyayaashooda Trump iyo Biden . ' ' Sidoo kale , inta arrimahan socdaan lagama hadli doono arrimo ay ka mid yihiin karoonaha iyo Shiinaha - Tom iyo Jerry way dagaalami doonaan waxaan ula jeedaa Trump iyo Biden ' , ayuu yiri . Sidoo kale wargeyska saldhigiisu yahay magaalada London ee dalka Ingiriiska laguna magacaabo Al - Carabiya Al jadiid , ayaa sheegay in iyadoo Biden uu ku dhowyahay in uu guul ka gaaro doorashada oo waliba uu ku kalsoonyahay ay haddana arrintaas Mareykanka u tahay marxalad cusub , marka la eego xiisaha doorashada iyo loollanka adag ee la galay . Wargeyska AL Akhbaar ee ka soo baxa dalka Lubnaan ayaa isna sheegay in Mareykanku uu wajahayo ' xiisad siyaasadeed oo mas'uliyadeeda uu leeyahay madaxweweyne Donald Trump ' . Qalalaasaha siyaasadeed ee dhanka garsoorka Iyadoo Trump uu wacad ku maray inuu tagayo maxkamadda si uu uga hor-tago sharci ahaanta waraaqaha cod-bixinta ee boostada , ayaa haddana wargayska London ka soo baxa ee Al-Quds Al-Arabi uu qoray in ' jahwareerkan ' siyaasadeed uu isu rogi karo ' xiisad weyn oo xagga garsoorka ah , haddii Donald Trump uu fuliyo ballanqaadkiisa ahaa in uu maxakamad aadayo . ' Si kastaba ha noqatee natiijadaan waxay horseedi kartaa dacwad ka dhan ah codbixinta iyo hannaanka tirinta codadka ee gobollada muhiimka ah . Waxaana Kiisas laga xareeyay gobollo gaar ah . Wargeyska Al-Carab ee ka soo baxa magaalada London ayaa sidoo kale is waydiiyay su'aashaan : ' Doorashada Mareykanka ma waxaa lagu go'aamin doonaa qolka maxkamadda ? ' Wargeyska Al Sharqul Qadariya , ayaa isana meesha ka saaray in Biden ama Trump midkoodna uu quusan doono haddii midkood looga adkaado doorashada . text: ' ቪክትሪ ላፕ ' ትብል ኣልበም ኒፕሰይ ሃስል ፡ ሓንቲ ካብ ብልጹት ተባሂላ ንሽልማት ግራሚ ተሓጽያ ዝነበረት'ያ እቲ ጥርጡር ቀታሊ ኤሪክ ሆልድር ወዲ 29 ኮይኑ ፡ ካብ ሰንበት ጀሚሩ ካብ ፖሊስ ክሃድም ከም ዝጸንሓ'ውን ኣመልኪቶም ። ጠንቂ እቲ ቅትልት ኣብ ሞንጎ ራፕር ኒፕሲ ሃስል ኤሪክ ሆልድርን ዝነበረ ውልቃዊ ጉዳይም ከም ዝኾነ መርመርቲ እቲ ጉዳይ ሓቢሮም ። ፖሊስ ሎስ ኣንጀለስ ስም ጥርጡር ቀታሊ ኒፕሲይ ሃስል ትማሊ ወግዓዊ ገይሩ ነይሩ ። እዚ ድሕሪ እቲ ንዝኽሪ ኒፕሲይ ሃስል ተባሂሉ ዝተገብረ ስነ-ስርዓት ብዘጋጠመ ዕግርግር ስዒቡ ኢዩ ወግዓዊ ኮይኑ ። ሰብ መዚ ሎስ ኣንጀለስ ከም ዝገለጽዎ ፡ ብቕትለት ኒፕሲይ ሃስል ተጠርጢሩ ኣብ ቀይዲ ዝወዓለ ኤሪክ ሆልደር ዝተባህለ ወዲ 29 መንእሰይ ኢዩ ። ብሰኑይ ንዝኽሩ ኣብ ዝተገብረ መደብ ብዘጋጠመ ምብርጋግ 19 ሰባት ተጎዲኦም ። ናይዚ ምኽንያት ግን ንጹር ኣይኮነን ዘሎ ። ምኽንያት እቲ ዕግርግር ድምጺ ጥይት ስለ ዝተሰምዐ ኢዩ ዝብል ዘረባ ፡ ፖሊስ ሓቅነቱ ርጉጽ ኣይኮነን ኢሉ ኣሎ ። ፍሉጣት ስነጥበበኛታት ዓለምን ሰበስልጣን መንግስትን ፡ ኣደነቕቱን ብሞት እቲ ኣብ ንእስነቱ ትማሊ ሰንበት ዝተቐትለ ብኒፕሰይ ሃስል ተባሂሉ ዝጽዋዕ ኤርትራዊ-ኣመሪካዊ ኤርሚያስ ኣስገዶም ዝተሰምዖም ሓዘን ይገልጹ ኣለዉ ። ' ክርድኣኒ ኣይክልን'ዩ ። መንፈሰይ ተናዊጹ'ሎ ! ክቡር እግዚኣብሄር ፡ ንመንፈሱ ብሰላም ኣዕርፎ ፡ ንፈተውቱ ድማ መለኮታዊ ምጽንናዕ ሃቦም ! በቲ ዝበጽሓካ ኣዝየ እሓዝን ' ክትብል ህብብቲ ድምጻዊት ሪሃና ዝተሰመዓ ጓሂ ገሊጻ ። ካልኦት ከም በዓል ድሬክ ፡ ፑሻ ቲ ዝበሉ ፍሉጣት ናይ ራፕ ሙዚቀኛታት ዝኾኑ ፈተውቱ'ውን ብወገኖም ብሃንደበታዊ ሞት ' ኒፕሰይ ' ዝተሰምዖም ሓዘን ብመንገዲ ትዊተር ገሊጾም ። ' ፍሉይ ፍጥረት ' ምንባሩ ዝገለጸ ፑሻ ' ምኻድካ ዘሕዝን'ዩ ኒፕ ፡ ዝተባረኽካ ምዃንካ ጥራይ'ዩ ሰላም ክህበኒ ኪኢሉ ዘሎ . . ብልጽቲ ዓመት ብሙዚቃ ብሓባር ስለዝተቛደስና ክብሪ ይስምዓኒ ክብል ' ንዝነበሮም ምትሕብባር ዘኪሩ ። ሚኒስተር ዜና ኤርትራ ኣቶ የማነ ገብረመስቀል ብወገኑ ፡ ' በቲ ዘሕዝን ሞት ናይ ህቡብ ስነጥበባዊን ነጋዳይን ኤርሚያስ ደበሳይ ( ኒፕሰይ ሃስል ) ምስመዐይ ኣዝየ እሓዝን ፡ ብሰላም የዕርፍካ ፡ ንቤተሰብ ጽንዓት ይሃብኩም ' ክብል ኣብ ትዊተር ጽሒፉ ። ከንቲባ ከተማ ሎስ ኣንጀለስ'ውን ንሞት ኒፕሰይ ' ዘጒሂ ትራጀዲ'ዩ ' ክብል ብምግላጽ ፡ ማሕበረሰብ ናይቲ ስነጥበበኛ ብሓባር ክሓዝኑንን ክጸናንዑን ጸዊዑ ። ብዙሓት ኤርትርውያንን ኣፍሪቃውያንን ድማ ብሞት ኤርሚያስ ዝተሰምዖም ሓዘን ኣብ ዝተፈላለዩ መሕበራዊ መራኸቢታት ይገልጹ'ለዉ ። ኣብ ሚያዝያ 2018 ንኤርትራ ኣብ ዝበጽሓሉ ዝነበረ እዋን ፡ ምስ ኤርትራውያን ቤተሰቡን ፡ ምስ ፕረዚደንት ኢሳይያስ ኣፈወርቂ ተራኺቡ ነይሩ ። እቲ ካብ ኤርትራዊ ኣቦ ዝውለድ ራፐር ኤርሚያስ ኣስገዶም ( ኒፕሰይ ሃሰል ) ትማሊ ሰንበት 31 መጋቢት'ዩ ብዝተተኮሶ ጠያይቲ ኣብ ኣመሪካዊት ከተማ ሎስ ኣንጀለስ ተቐቲሉ ። እቲ ወዲ 33 ራፐር ፡ ኣብ ጥቓ ዝውንኖ መሸጢ ዓለባ ' ማራቶን ክሎዚን ' ዝተቀትለ ክኸውን እንከሎ ፡ ካልኦት ክልተ ሰባት'ውን ከም ዝቖሰሉ ሎስ ኣንጀለስ ታይምስ ገሊጹ ። ራፐር ኤርሚያስ ኣስገዶም ( ኒፕሰይ ሃስል ) ' ቪክትሪ ' ዝብል ኣልበም ኒፕሰይ ሃሰል ፡ ኣብዚ ዓመት ኣብ ምድብ ብሉጽ ኣልበም ራፕ ፡ ሕጹይ ሽልማት ግራሚ ኮይኑ ቐሪቡ ነይሩ ። ክሳብ ሕጂ መንነት እቶም ቀተልቲ ከም ዘይተፈለጠ'ውን ፖሊስ እታ ከተማ ገሊጹ ። ዕግርግር ኣብ ዝበዝሖ ከባቢ ሎስ ኣንጀለስ ካሊፎኒያ ዝዓበየ ኒፕሰይ ሃስል ፡ ትማሊ ሰንበት ንጉሆ ' ' ሓያላት ጸላእቲ ክህልዉኻ ፡ ትዕድልቲ እዩ ' ' ክብል ኣብ ትዊተር ጽሒፉ ነይሩ ።

example.input: ' ቪክትሪ ላፕ ' ትብል ኣልበም ኒፕሰይ ሃስል ፡ ሓንቲ ካብ ብልጹት ተባሂላ ንሽልማት ግራሚ ተሓጽያ ዝነበረት'ያ እቲ ጥርጡር ቀታሊ ኤሪክ ሆልድር ወዲ 29 ኮይኑ ፡ ካብ ሰንበት ጀሚሩ ካብ ፖሊስ ክሃድም ከም ዝጸንሓ'ውን ኣመልኪቶም ። ጠንቂ እቲ ቅትልት ኣብ ሞንጎ ራፕር ኒፕሲ ሃስል ኤሪክ ሆልድርን ዝነበረ ውልቃዊ ጉዳይም ከም ዝኾነ መርመርቲ እቲ ጉዳይ ሓቢሮም ። ፖሊስ ሎስ ኣንጀለስ ስም ጥርጡር ቀታሊ ኒፕሲይ ሃስል ትማሊ ወግዓዊ ገይሩ ነይሩ ። እዚ ድሕሪ እቲ ንዝኽሪ ኒፕሲይ ሃስል ተባሂሉ ዝተገብረ ስነ-ስርዓት ብዘጋጠመ ዕግርግር ስዒቡ ኢዩ ወግዓዊ ኮይኑ ። ሰብ መዚ ሎስ ኣንጀለስ ከም ዝገለጽዎ ፡ ብቕትለት ኒፕሲይ ሃስል ተጠርጢሩ ኣብ ቀይዲ ዝወዓለ ኤሪክ ሆልደር ዝተባህለ ወዲ 29 መንእሰይ ኢዩ ። ብሰኑይ ንዝኽሩ ኣብ ዝተገብረ መደብ ብዘጋጠመ ምብርጋግ 19 ሰባት ተጎዲኦም ። ናይዚ ምኽንያት ግን ንጹር ኣይኮነን ዘሎ ። ምኽንያት እቲ ዕግርግር ድምጺ ጥይት ስለ ዝተሰምዐ ኢዩ ዝብል ዘረባ ፡ ፖሊስ ሓቅነቱ ርጉጽ ኣይኮነን ኢሉ ኣሎ ። ፍሉጣት ስነጥበበኛታት ዓለምን ሰበስልጣን መንግስትን ፡ ኣደነቕቱን ብሞት እቲ ኣብ ንእስነቱ ትማሊ ሰንበት ዝተቐትለ ብኒፕሰይ ሃስል ተባሂሉ ዝጽዋዕ ኤርትራዊ-ኣመሪካዊ ኤርሚያስ ኣስገዶም ዝተሰምዖም ሓዘን ይገልጹ ኣለዉ ። ' ክርድኣኒ ኣይክልን'ዩ ። መንፈሰይ ተናዊጹ'ሎ ! text: ' ቪክትሪ ላፕ ' ትብል ኣልበም ኒፕሰይ ሃስል ፡ ሓንቲ ካብ ብልጹት ተባሂላ ንሽልማት ግራሚ ተሓጽያ ዝነበረት'ያ እቲ ጥርጡር ቀታሊ ኤሪክ ሆልድር ወዲ 29 ኮይኑ ፡ ካብ ሰንበት ጀሚሩ ካብ ፖሊስ ክሃድም ከም ዝጸንሓ'ውን ኣመልኪቶም ። ጠንቂ እቲ ቅትልት ኣብ ሞንጎ ራፕር ኒፕሲ ሃስል ኤሪክ ሆልድርን ዝነበረ ውልቃዊ ጉዳይም ከም ዝኾነ መርመርቲ እቲ ጉዳይ ሓቢሮም ። ፖሊስ ሎስ ኣንጀለስ ስም ጥርጡር ቀታሊ ኒፕሲይ ሃስል ትማሊ ወግዓዊ ገይሩ ነይሩ ። እዚ ድሕሪ እቲ ንዝኽሪ ኒፕሲይ ሃስል ተባሂሉ ዝተገብረ ስነ-ስርዓት ብዘጋጠመ ዕግርግር ስዒቡ ኢዩ ወግዓዊ ኮይኑ ። ሰብ መዚ ሎስ ኣንጀለስ ከም ዝገለጽዎ ፡ ብቕትለት ኒፕሲይ ሃስል ተጠርጢሩ ኣብ ቀይዲ ዝወዓለ ኤሪክ ሆልደር ዝተባህለ ወዲ 29 መንእሰይ ኢዩ ። ብሰኑይ ንዝኽሩ ኣብ ዝተገብረ መደብ ብዘጋጠመ ምብርጋግ 19 ሰባት ተጎዲኦም ። ናይዚ ምኽንያት ግን ንጹር ኣይኮነን ዘሎ ። ምኽንያት እቲ ዕግርግር ድምጺ ጥይት ስለ ዝተሰምዐ ኢዩ ዝብል ዘረባ ፡ ፖሊስ ሓቅነቱ ርጉጽ ኣይኮነን ኢሉ ኣሎ ። ፍሉጣት ስነጥበበኛታት ዓለምን ሰበስልጣን መንግስትን ፡ ኣደነቕቱን ብሞት እቲ ኣብ ንእስነቱ ትማሊ ሰንበት ዝተቐትለ ብኒፕሰይ ሃስል ተባሂሉ ዝጽዋዕ ኤርትራዊ-ኣመሪካዊ ኤርሚያስ ኣስገዶም ዝተሰምዖም ሓዘን ይገልጹ ኣለዉ ። ' ክርድኣኒ ኣይክልን'ዩ ። መንፈሰይ ተናዊጹ'ሎ ! ክቡር እግዚኣብሄር ፡ ንመንፈሱ ብሰላም ኣዕርፎ ፡ ንፈተውቱ ድማ መለኮታዊ ምጽንናዕ ሃቦም ! በቲ ዝበጽሓካ ኣዝየ እሓዝን ' ክትብል ህብብቲ ድምጻዊት ሪሃና ዝተሰመዓ ጓሂ ገሊጻ ። ካልኦት ከም በዓል ድሬክ ፡ ፑሻ ቲ ዝበሉ ፍሉጣት ናይ ራፕ ሙዚቀኛታት ዝኾኑ ፈተውቱ'ውን ብወገኖም ብሃንደበታዊ ሞት ' ኒፕሰይ ' ዝተሰምዖም ሓዘን ብመንገዲ ትዊተር ገሊጾም ። ' ፍሉይ ፍጥረት ' ምንባሩ ዝገለጸ ፑሻ ' ምኻድካ ዘሕዝን'ዩ ኒፕ ፡ ዝተባረኽካ ምዃንካ ጥራይ'ዩ ሰላም ክህበኒ ኪኢሉ ዘሎ . . ብልጽቲ ዓመት ብሙዚቃ ብሓባር ስለዝተቛደስና ክብሪ ይስምዓኒ ክብል ' ንዝነበሮም ምትሕብባር ዘኪሩ ። ሚኒስተር ዜና ኤርትራ ኣቶ የማነ ገብረመስቀል ብወገኑ ፡ ' በቲ ዘሕዝን ሞት ናይ ህቡብ ስነጥበባዊን ነጋዳይን ኤርሚያስ ደበሳይ ( ኒፕሰይ ሃስል ) ምስመዐይ ኣዝየ እሓዝን ፡ ብሰላም የዕርፍካ ፡ ንቤተሰብ ጽንዓት ይሃብኩም ' ክብል ኣብ ትዊተር ጽሒፉ ። ከንቲባ ከተማ ሎስ ኣንጀለስ'ውን ንሞት ኒፕሰይ ' ዘጒሂ ትራጀዲ'ዩ ' ክብል ብምግላጽ ፡ ማሕበረሰብ ናይቲ ስነጥበበኛ ብሓባር ክሓዝኑንን ክጸናንዑን ጸዊዑ ። ብዙሓት ኤርትርውያንን ኣፍሪቃውያንን ድማ ብሞት ኤርሚያስ ዝተሰምዖም ሓዘን ኣብ ዝተፈላለዩ መሕበራዊ መራኸቢታት ይገልጹ'ለዉ ። ኣብ ሚያዝያ 2018 ንኤርትራ ኣብ ዝበጽሓሉ ዝነበረ እዋን ፡ ምስ ኤርትራውያን ቤተሰቡን ፡ ምስ ፕረዚደንት ኢሳይያስ ኣፈወርቂ ተራኺቡ ነይሩ ። እቲ ካብ ኤርትራዊ ኣቦ ዝውለድ ራፐር ኤርሚያስ ኣስገዶም ( ኒፕሰይ ሃሰል ) ትማሊ ሰንበት 31 መጋቢት'ዩ ብዝተተኮሶ ጠያይቲ ኣብ ኣመሪካዊት ከተማ ሎስ ኣንጀለስ ተቐቲሉ ። እቲ ወዲ 33 ራፐር ፡ ኣብ ጥቓ ዝውንኖ መሸጢ ዓለባ ' ማራቶን ክሎዚን ' ዝተቀትለ ክኸውን እንከሎ ፡ ካልኦት ክልተ ሰባት'ውን ከም ዝቖሰሉ ሎስ ኣንጀለስ ታይምስ ገሊጹ ። ራፐር ኤርሚያስ ኣስገዶም ( ኒፕሰይ ሃስል ) ' ቪክትሪ ' ዝብል ኣልበም ኒፕሰይ ሃሰል ፡ ኣብዚ ዓመት ኣብ ምድብ ብሉጽ ኣልበም ራፕ ፡ ሕጹይ ሽልማት ግራሚ ኮይኑ ቐሪቡ ነይሩ ። ክሳብ ሕጂ መንነት እቶም ቀተልቲ ከም ዘይተፈለጠ'ውን ፖሊስ እታ ከተማ ገሊጹ ። ዕግርግር ኣብ ዝበዝሖ ከባቢ ሎስ ኣንጀለስ ካሊፎኒያ ዝዓበየ ኒፕሰይ ሃስል ፡ ትማሊ ሰንበት ንጉሆ ' ' ሓያላት ጸላእቲ ክህልዉኻ ፡ ትዕድልቲ እዩ ' ' ክብል ኣብ ትዊተር ጽሒፉ ነይሩ ።<|im_end|>
